fields.name: schema_version
fields.description: Version of the configuration format, which this library reads. Required.

fields.name: body
fields.description: What the terrain lies on: a plane in meters, or a whole body (a sphere, ellipsoid or shape model) in longitude and latitude degrees.

fields.name: source
fields.description: Where the heights come from: a GeoTIFF, a chain of sources or synthetic noise, with its upsampling; unset is fBm noise 400 m in wavelength and 12 m in amplitude at the datum.

fields.name: layers
fields.description: Relief and features added to the source's heights, applied in order: noise, craters, boulders and more.

fields.name: outputs
fields.description: What to produce, at what resolution and where, each over its own extent or the whole body: heightmaps, crater and boulder lists, boulder models, albedo, meshes and reports. Each is returned, and written to its path when it has one.

fields.name: albedo
fields.description: The terrain's albedo: a source and the layers that change it, written by albedo outputs; none when unset.

fields.name: materials
fields.description: The material map: soil, sand, dust, bedrock and rock shares, and their Hapke parameters, written by materials and photometry outputs; none when unset.

alternatives.description: A flat projected frame in meters, for local sites.
A whole body such as a planet or moon: positions in longitude and latitude (degrees) and features generated over the whole body.

fields.name: radius_m
fields.description: Radius of the body's datum sphere, in meters. Must be positive. Required.

alternatives.description: A whole body shaped as a triaxial ellipsoid, such as an elongated moon or asteroid: planetocentric longitude and latitude (degrees), heights along the direction from the center, and features generated over the whole body.

fields.name: radii_m
fields.description: Semi-axes a, b and c of the datum ellipsoid in meters, along x (longitude 0), y (longitude 90) and z (the north pole). Holds exactly 3 items. Each must be positive. Required.

alternatives.description: A whole star-shaped body such as an asteroid from a shape model, resampled along rays from its origin; heights are radial, in longitude and latitude degrees.

fields.name: path
fields.description: Shape model in body-fixed coordinates around its origin: a Gaskell ICQ model (.icq) or a closed mesh (.obj, .gltf, .glb or .stl); relative paths resolve against the configuration's folder. Required.

fields.name: q
fields.description: Intervals per cube face edge of the radial grid the model is resampled on; unset keeps an ICQ model's own Q and uses 256 for a mesh. Must be from 1 to 4096.

fields.name: meters_per_unit
fields.description: Meters per unit of the file's coordinates; unset is 1000 for an ICQ model, whose coordinates are kilometers, and 1 for a mesh. Must be positive.

fields.name: min_x
fields.description: Lower edge along x.

fields.name: min_y
fields.description: Lower edge along y.

fields.name: max_x
fields.description: Upper edge along x; above min_x.

fields.name: max_y
fields.description: Upper edge along y; above min_y.

alternatives.description: The value of the nearest cell center: blocky, but never mixes values.
Linear in each axis over the four surrounding cells.
Keys cubic convolution (a = -0.5) over the sixteen surrounding cells: smooth, for upscaling DEMs.
Another name for cubic: the Catmull-Rom spline is the same kernel.
The three-lobe Lanczos kernel over the 36 surrounding cells: sharper than cubic, with slight ringing at steps.
The cubic B-spline over the sixteen surrounding cells: the smoothest, but it smooths the cells themselves.
Random midpoint displacement: each level halves the node spacing down to the sample spacing, adding fractal detail without changing the posts.

fields.name: fractal_dimension
fields.description: Fractal dimension, 2 smooth and 3 rough: each square or diamond step scales the displacement by 2^-((3 - F) / 2). Unset estimates it from the median height differences of the posts at lags of 1 to 8 posts. Must be from 2 to 3.

fields.name: scale_m
fields.description: Displacement standard deviation in meters at the posts' last step; unset estimates it per fit_window_px window. Must not be negative.

fields.name: fit_window_px
fields.description: Side in posts of the overlapping windows, centered every half side, that an unset scale_m is fitted over; each node's scale is bilinear between the windows around it. 0 fits one scale to a sample of the posts; else at least 4. Must be from 0 to 1024 px.

fields.name: interp
fields.description: How new nodes are filled from the coarser ones and samples read between the finest nodes.

descriptions: Square nodes the mean of their four corners, diamond nodes the mean of their four neighbors, samples bilinear between nodes.
Catmull-Rom splines over four nodes along each axis, as the VIPER terrain expansion does: smoother, with fewer lattice creases.

fields.name: min_pixel_size_m
fields.description: Finest node spacing in meters the posts are refined to; 0 refines down to the sample spacing. Must not be negative.

fields.name: seed
fields.description: Seed of the displacements.

fields.name: mode
fields.description: How each source meets the gaps of those before it: none switches outright, feather fades the edge's height difference out across the gap, height shifts the later source to meet the earlier one's heights (C0) and slope to meet its heights and slopes (C1). The match is solved on the posts of the source before each gap.

descriptions: Each cell takes the first source with data, unchanged: a step where a gap begins.
Adds the height difference at the nearest edge post to the later source, fading it to 0 across width_m of the gap: the cheapest, without a solve.
Shifts the later source by the edge's height difference spread smoothly into the gap, fading out over decay_length_m beyond an open edge: heights meet (C0), keeping the later source's relief.
As height, with a biharmonic spread that matches slopes at the edge as well (C1).

fields.name: width_m
fields.description: Width in meters of the band inside a gap over which feather fades the height difference at the edge to 0. Must be positive.

fields.name: decay_length_m
fields.description: Length in meters over which height and slope fade the shift out where a gap is open, beyond a source's edge; it is 0 from three decay lengths on. A hole much narrower than it takes the whole shift. Must be positive.

fields.name: enabled
fields.description: Includes this layer in the stack; disabled layers are skipped.

fields.name: basis
fields.description: Single-octave noise the fractal is built from.

descriptions: Improved Perlin gradient noise: smooth, general-purpose relief.
Simplex gradient noise: smooth relief, an alternative to Perlin.
Value noise: random values interpolated over a lattice; blockier than gradient noise.
Cellular noise from the distance to the nearest feature point: cones and basins.
Cellular noise from the distance to the second-nearest feature point.
Cellular noise F2 - F1: ridges along cell borders, like cracked ground.
Voronoi cells, each at one random height: flat polygonal plateaus and terraces.

fields.name: fractal
fields.description: How the octaves of the basis noise are combined.

descriptions: Fractional Brownian motion: a weighted sum of octaves, the general-purpose choice.
Ridged multifractal: sharp crests from inverted absolute noise, like eroded ridges.
Sum of absolute-value octaves: rounded, puffy forms.
Hybrid multifractal: smooth lowlands and rough highlands.

fields.name: blend
fields.description: How this layer combines with the height of the layers before it; the first enabled layer sets the height instead.

descriptions: Adds the layer to the height so far.
Keeps the higher of the height so far and the layer.
Keeps the lower of the height so far and the layer.
Multiplies the height so far by (layer / amplitude + 1) / 2, so the layer modulates roughness by region.

fields.name: seed
fields.description: Seed of the noise; changing it gives a different pattern of the same character.

fields.name: wavelength_m
fields.description: Wavelength of the first, broadest octave, in meters; sets the size of the largest features. Must be positive.

fields.name: amplitude_m
fields.description: Largest height of the layer above or below 0, in meters; unset is 0.1 times the wavelength, near the lunar highland median slope at any wavelength.

fields.name: octaves
fields.description: Number of octaves; each one adds detail at a shorter wavelength. Must be from 1 to 32.

fields.name: lacunarity
fields.description: Frequency ratio between successive octaves. Must be above 1.

fields.name: gain
fields.description: Weight ratio between successive octaves; higher values give rougher terrain. Unused when the Hurst exponent is set. Must be positive.

fields.name: hurst
fields.description: Hurst exponent that sets the octave gain to lacunarity^-hurst: near 1 is smooth, lower is rougher at short baselines. Unset uses the gain.

fields.name: offset
fields.description: Ridge offset of the ridged and hybrid multifractal types. Must be positive.

fields.name: warp_amplitude_m
fields.description: Domain warp displacement in meters, which bends the noise into swirled shapes; 0 disables warping. Must not be negative.

fields.name: warp_wavelength_m
fields.description: Wavelength of the warp field, in meters. Must be positive.

alternatives.description: A heightmap read from a GeoTIFF in its own projected coordinates, its cells upsampled to finer spacings, to add relief to a real DEM.

fields.name: path
fields.description: GeoTIFF to read the heights from; relative paths resolve against the configuration's folder. Required.

fields.name: band
fields.description: Band of the file to read, counting from 0.

fields.name: scale
fields.description: Factor each sample is multiplied by, replacing the band's scale from the file's GDAL metadata. Unset keeps the file's.

fields.name: offset_m
fields.description: Added to each scaled sample, replacing the band's offset from the file's GDAL metadata. Unset keeps the file's.

fields.name: crop
fields.description: Box in the raster's CRS units to use; unset uses the whole file.

fields.name: effective_pixel_size_m
fields.description: Cell size in meters the heights truly resolve, for a DEM that was upsampled or smoothed before it was saved; it replaces the cell size as the scale below which the source resolves no features. Unset uses the cell size. Must be positive.

fields.name: upsampling
fields.description: How the posts are refined between them and at finer spacings: a kernel name such as cubic or lanczos3, or an object with a "type" and its settings, such as {"type": "diamond_square"} for fractal detail.

alternatives.description: Several sources tried in order, each filling where those before it have no data; its grid is the first one's.

fields.name: sources
fields.description: Sources tried in order, each filling where those before it have no data, each upsampled as it says; the chain's grid is the first one's. Holds at least 1 item.

fields.name: seams
fields.description: How each source is matched to the sources before it where it fills their gaps; by default each switches outright.

alternatives.description: Heights generated from a stack of fractal noise layers over an unbounded plane or the whole body; outputs give their own extents and pixel sizes.

fields.name: elevation_m
fields.description: Height in meters added everywhere.

fields.name: stack
fields.description: Noise layers, combined in order: the first enabled layer sets the height and each later one is combined with it by its blend mode. Unset is one layer of fBm noise 400 m in wavelength and 12 m in amplitude; an empty stack gives a flat source. Holds 0 to 8 items.

fields.name: pixel_size_m
fields.description: Spacing in meters of posts the noise is sampled at, as for a DEM of that cell size, which upsampling refines. Unset evaluates the noise at every point, at any spacing. Must be positive.

fields.name: upsampling
fields.description: How the posts are refined between them and at finer spacings: a kernel name such as cubic or lanczos3, or an object with a "type" and its settings, such as {"type": "diamond_square"} for fractal detail. Needs pixel_size_m; unset is cubic.

alternatives.description: The shape-model body's own labels refined by an upsampler; the default source on such a body.

fields.name: upsampling
fields.description: How the posts are refined between them and at finer spacings: a kernel name such as cubic or lanczos3, or an object with a "type" and its settings, such as {"type": "diamond_square"} for fractal detail. Unset is cubic.

fields.name: start_m
fields.description: Diameter in meters where this segment begins; it runs up to the next segment's start. Must not be negative.

fields.name: coefficient
fields.description: Coefficient of N(>=D) = coefficient D^-exponent, the cumulative count per m^2 with D in meters. Must be positive.

fields.name: exponent
fields.description: Exponent of the segment's power law; larger values give relatively more small craters. Must be positive.

fields.name: min_m
fields.description: Smallest diameter of the band in meters. Must be positive.

fields.name: max_m
fields.description: Largest diameter of the band in meters, above min_m. Must be positive.

fields.name: density
fields.description: Count per m^2 with diameters in the band, spread uniformly across it; a relative weight when total is set. Must not be negative.

alternatives.description: A cumulative power law, N(>=D) = coefficient D^-exponent per m^2 with D in meters.

fields.name: coefficient
fields.description: Coefficient of N(>=D) = coefficient D^-exponent, the cumulative count per m^2 with D in meters; scales how many there are. Must be positive.

fields.name: exponent
fields.description: Exponent of the power law; larger values give relatively more small craters or boulders. Must be positive.

alternatives.description: A cumulative distribution made of power-law segments over diameter ranges.

fields.name: segments
fields.description: Power-law segments in strictly increasing order of start, each running to the next one's start; they must meet at their joins.

alternatives.description: A cumulative distribution from a table of diameters and counts N(>=D), in units you choose.

fields.name: diameters
fields.description: Table diameters in diameter units, strictly increasing; counts are interpolated linearly in log D and log N between them. Holds at least 2 items. Each must be positive.

fields.name: cumulative
fields.description: Cumulative count N(>=D) at each diameter, per area unit; not increasing. Each must be positive.

fields.name: diameter_unit
fields.description: Meters per table diameter unit: 1 for meters, 1000 for km. Must be positive.

fields.name: area_unit
fields.description: Square meters per table area unit: 1 for m^2, 1e6 for km^2. Must be positive.

alternatives.description: The craters a production function leaves on a surface of a given age, scaled by a chronology, with no erosion; cap it with an equilibrium in a minimum.

fields.name: production
fields.description: Production function that gives the craters' sizes.

descriptions: Neukum et al. (2001) lunar production function, valid from 10 m to 300 km.
The Neukum production function continued below 10 m as a power law of slope -2.85, valid from 2.5 m to 300 km.
Ivanov (2001) Martian production function, valid from 15 m to 362 km.

fields.name: chronology
fields.description: Chronology that gives how many craters at least 1 km across the surface holds.

descriptions: Neukum et al. (2001) lunar chronology, for surfaces 0 to 4.6 Gyr old.
Ivanov (2001) Martian chronology, for surfaces 0 to 4.6 Gyr old.

fields.name: age_gyr
fields.description: Age of the surface in Gyr; older surfaces hold more craters. Must be from 0 to 4.6 Gyr.

alternatives.description: The least of several densities at each diameter, such as a production surface capped by an equilibrium.

fields.name: distributions
fields.description: Densities whose least cumulative count at each diameter is used; at least one.

alternatives.description: The Trask (1966) lunar equilibrium density, N(>=D) = 10^-1.1 D^-2.
The Hartmann (1984) lunar equilibrium density, N(>=D) = 10^-1.14 D^-1.83 per km^2 with D in km.
Moore's terrain-specific crater distributions for Lunar Roving Vehicle trafficability.

fields.name: terrain
fields.description: Terrain type whose crater distribution of Moore's to use.

descriptions: Moore's rough mare crater distribution: 10^-1 D^-2 per m^2 below 100 m, 10 D^-3 above.
Moore's smooth mare crater distribution: 10^-1 D^-2 per m^2 below 40 m, then D^-3, D^-1.68 from 100 m and D^-3 from 200 m.
Moore's uplands crater distribution: 10^-1 D^-2 per m^2 below 1 km, 10^2 D^-3 above.
Moore's heavily cratered distribution: 10^-1 D^-2 per m^2 up to 10 km.

alternatives.description: The VIPER environmental specification crater density, as synthterrain uses it; kept for comparison with synthterrain.
Counts per m^2 in diameter bands, each with diameters spread uniformly across it; none outside the bands.

fields.name: bands
fields.description: Diameter bands with their counts; overlapping bands add, and gaps between them hold none.

fields.name: total
fields.description: Count per m^2 of all bands together, shared in proportion to each band's density; 0 uses the densities as given. Must not be negative.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: Kind of distribution the value is drawn from.

descriptions: Always a.
Uniform between a and b.
Normal with mean a and standard deviation b.
Log-normal with median a and standard deviation b of the natural logarithm.
Uniform within each bin between edges, each bin drawn in proportion to its weight.

fields.name: a
fields.description: The constant value, the uniform's lower bound, the normal's mean or the log-normal's median.

fields.name: b
fields.description: The uniform's upper bound, or the standard deviation (of the natural logarithm for a log-normal); unused for a constant.

fields.name: min
fields.description: Lower bound drawn values are clamped to; unset leaves them unbounded below.

fields.name: max
fields.description: Upper bound drawn values are clamped to; unset leaves them unbounded above, which normal and log-normal kinds do not allow.

fields.name: edges
fields.description: With piecewise, the edges of the bins, at least two and strictly increasing; values are uniform within each bin. Empty for every other kind.

fields.name: weights
fields.description: With piecewise, the relative weight of each bin, one fewer than the edges and not all zero; each bin draws its share of the total. Empty for every other kind. Each must not be negative.

alternatives.description: Ages uniform over one lifetime for every diameter, so freshness is uniform between 0 and 1.

fields.name: lifetime_gyr
fields.description: Lifetime in Gyr that every crater's age is drawn uniformly within; with degradation, a crater this old is fully worn. Must be positive.

alternatives.description: Every crater is fresh, with age and lifetime zero.

Crater ages where small craters are in equilibrium: a crater lasts until the production rate replaces the equilibrium density, or the surface's age, with ages drawn from the chronology's formation rate.

fields.name: age_gyr
fields.description: Age of the surface in Gyr; it caps every crater's lifetime, so larger craters on an older surface can be older. Must be from 0 to 4.6 Gyr.

fields.name: production
fields.description: Production function whose rate, with the equilibrium, sets how long small craters last.

descriptions: Neukum et al. (2001) lunar production function, valid from 10 m to 300 km.
The Neukum production function continued below 10 m as a power law of slope -2.85, valid from 2.5 m to 300 km.
Ivanov (2001) Martian production function, valid from 15 m to 362 km.

fields.name: equilibrium
fields.description: Equilibrium density that, with the production rate, sets how long small craters last before they are erased.

descriptions: Trask (1966) lunar equilibrium, N(>=D) = 10^-1.1 D^-2, as the DSNE uses.
Hartmann (1984) lunar equilibrium, N(>=D) = 10^-1.14 D^-1.83 per km^2 with D in km.

fields.name: chronology
fields.description: Chronology whose formation rate the craters' ages are drawn from.

descriptions: Neukum et al. (2001) lunar chronology, for surfaces 0 to 4.6 Gyr old.
Ivanov (2001) Martian chronology, for surfaces 0 to 4.6 Gyr old.

alternatives.description: Ages from a freshness f between 0 and 1 drawn per crater, age = (1 - f) lifetime, with one lifetime for every diameter; freshness stands for age as in degree-of-freshness dating (Pohn and Offield 1970; Trang et al. 2015).

fields.name: lifetime_gyr
fields.description: Lifetime in Gyr of every crater: freshness 0 is this old, 1 is new; crater albedo such as ray fading reads these ages. Must be positive.

fields.name: freshness
fields.description: Distribution each crater's freshness is drawn from, also clamped to 0 to 1: 1 is fresh, 0 at the end of its lifetime; with freshness degradation, depth and rim scale with it.

fields.name: diameter_ratio
fields.description: Largest ratio of two craters' diameters for them to count as similar in size and be kept apart. Must be at least 1.

fields.name: separation
fields.description: Least distance between the centers of similar-size craters, in larger diameters; 0 disables spacing. Must not be negative.

fields.name: x
fields.description: Center along x in the surface's coordinates; the longitude in degrees on a sphere.

fields.name: y
fields.description: Center along y in the surface's coordinates; the latitude in degrees on a sphere.

fields.name: diameter_m
fields.description: Rim-to-rim diameter, in meters. Must be positive.

fields.name: age_gyr
fields.description: Age in Gyr; older craters are more degraded under a degradation model and are applied earlier in oldest-first order. Must not be negative.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Stable ID that seeds the crater's outline; 0 derives one from its position and diameter.

fields.name: depth_m
fields.description: Rim-to-floor depth in meters, in place of the one the degradation model and age give; unset keeps the model's. Must be positive.

fields.name: rim_height_m
fields.description: Height of the rim crest above the surface the crater formed on, in meters; needs a depth. Unset lowers the fresh rim in proportion to the depth. Must not be negative.

fields.name: replace
fields.description: Replaces whatever the terrain holds there with a sharp crater of this diameter and depth, cut into a plane fitted around it, such as a crater a DEM holds blurred; apply.replacement sets how far. It takes the irregular outline, secondaries and albedo generated craters get.

alternatives.description: Fresh simple-crater profile of Fassett and Thomson (2014), with synthterrain's variants.

fields.name: rim
fields.description: How the profile's interior and exterior fits are joined at the rim.

descriptions: The published fits, whose interior and exterior meet at 0.98 radii.
Interior fit extended to 1.0 radii so the rim lies at the stated diameter, as synthterrain's FT_Crater; leaves a small step at the rim.
A flat rim at the fresh rim height from 0.98 to 1.02 radii, after Fassett et al. (2022), as synthterrain's FTmod_Crater.

alternatives.description: Simple-crater profile of Martin, Parkes and Dunstan (2014), developed for the PANGU simulator; degradation rounds its rim.
Fresh simple-crater profile of Fassett and Thomson (2014), with synthterrain's variants.

fields.name: rim
fields.description: How the profile's interior and exterior fits are joined at the rim.

descriptions: The published fits, whose interior and exterior meet at 0.98 radii.
Interior fit extended to 1.0 radii so the rim lies at the stated diameter, as synthterrain's FT_Crater; leaves a small step at the rim.
A flat rim at the fresh rim height from 0.98 to 1.02 radii, after Fassett et al. (2022), as synthterrain's FTmod_Crater.

alternatives.description: Simple-crater profile of Martin, Parkes and Dunstan (2014), developed for the PANGU simulator; degradation rounds its rim.
A simple profile below the body's simple-to-complex transition, and complex craters with flat floors and central peaks above it.

fields.name: simple
fields.description: Profile of the simple craters, those below the body's simple-to-complex transition diameter.

fields.name: coefficient
fields.description: Diffusivity of a 1 km crater, in m^2/Myr; higher values wear craters down faster. Must be positive.

fields.name: exponent
fields.description: Exponent of the diameter in coefficient (D / 1 km)^exponent; 0 gives the same diffusivity for every crater size.

fields.name: min_diameter_m
fields.description: Diameter in meters below which the diffusivity is held at its value at this diameter. Must not be negative.

alternatives.description: Scales depth and rim height linearly with freshness, down to a cutoff depth ratio at the end of a crater's lifetime.

fields.name: cutoff_depth_ratio
fields.description: Depth over diameter of a crater at the end of its lifetime; lower values let old craters wear shallower. Must be above 0 and below 0.1.

alternatives.description: Craters stay fresh, optionally all with one depth to diameter ratio.

fields.name: depth_ratio
fields.description: Depth over diameter given to every crater; unset keeps each crater's fresh depth for the body. Must be positive.

alternatives.description: Wears craters down by topographic diffusion, from each crater's diameter and age.

fields.name: diffusivity
fields.description: Model of the diffusion age each crater has from its diameter and age. The named fits are lunar; matched follows any steady-state ages, such as Martian ones from Ivanov's production function.

descriptions: With steady-state ages, the diffusivity that wears each crater to Fassett et al.'s (2022) visibility cutoff, depth 0.04 of the diameter, at the end of its equilibrium lifetime, as they derive it, for the layer's own profile; fassett_2022_hartmann for other ages.
Lunar size-dependent diffusivity of Fassett et al. (2022) for the Hartmann equilibrium, 3.6 D^0.87 m^2/Myr with D in km.
Lunar size-dependent diffusivity of Fassett et al. (2022) for the Trask equilibrium, 3.1 D^1.05 m^2/Myr with D in km.
Lunar diffusivity of Fassett and Thomson (2014), 5.5 m^2/Myr for every crater size; it erases craters below a few hundred meters within a small share of their lifetimes.
Fassett and Thomson's (2014) lunar diffusion age against crater age, independent of size; suits kilometer-scale craters.
A diffusivity of your own, coefficient (D / 1 km)^exponent m^2/Myr, from the power_law settings.

fields.name: power_law
fields.description: The diffusivity used when the diffusivity model is power_law.

fields.name: reach_radii
fields.description: Distance from the center, in crater radii, out to which the diffused profile is solved and held at 0; at least the fresh profile's reach.

fields.name: start_radii
fields.description: Distance from the center, in crater radii, up to which the interior is fully replaced. Must not be negative.

fields.name: end_radii
fields.description: Distance from the center, in crater radii, from which the surrounding terrain is draped unchanged. Must be positive.

fields.name: shape
fields.description: Curve of the transition from the replaced interior to the exterior.

descriptions: Straight ramp: continuous, with kinks at both ends.
Cubic 3t^2 - 2t^3: continuous slope across the transition.
Quintic 6t^5 - 15t^4 + 10t^3: continuous slope and curvature, the smoothest join.
Gaussian falloff with sigma a third of the band, rescaled to end at zero.

fields.name: start_radii
fields.description: Distance from the center, in crater radii, up to which a replacing crater replaces the terrain in full. Must be positive.

fields.name: end_radii
fields.description: Distance from the center, in crater radii, from which nothing is replaced; at most the profile's reach, and unset for that reach, so the replaced crater's rim goes too. Must be positive.

fields.name: fit_width_radii
fields.description: Width, in crater radii, of the ring outside end_radii that the replacing crater's plane datum is fitted on. Must be positive.

fields.name: enabled
fields.description: Gives eligible craters irregular, non-circular outlines; off keeps every crater round.

fields.name: seed
fields.description: Seed the outlines are drawn with, along with each crater's ID; changing it reshapes every irregular crater. Unset follows the layer's seed.

fields.name: min_diameter_m
fields.description: Smallest diameter, in meters, of craters made irregular. Must not be negative.

fields.name: max_diameter_m
fields.description: Largest diameter, in meters, of craters made irregular; unset has no upper limit. Must not be negative.

fields.name: min_age_gyr
fields.description: Youngest age, in Gyr, of craters made irregular. Must not be negative.

fields.name: max_age_gyr
fields.description: Oldest age, in Gyr, of craters made irregular; unset has no upper limit. Must not be negative.

fields.name: manual
fields.description: Makes manual craters irregular too; otherwise only generated and replacing craters are.

fields.name: rough_share
fields.description: Share of eligible craters given rough, wavy rims. Must be from 0 to 1.

fields.name: model
fields.description: How rough rims are drawn.

descriptions: Rim harmonics with amplitudes falling as a power of the harmonic number, of a given RMS: a simple, configurable spectrum.
The fitted rim-crest spectra of fresh lunar craters of Du et al. (2024), from each crater's diameter.

fields.name: scatter
fields.description: With du_2024, scatters each crater's spectrum by the fits' measured misfits and noise.

fields.name: max_deviation
fields.description: With du_2024, the largest deviation of a rim from a circle, in radii; outlines beyond it are scaled down to it. Must be above 0 and at most 0.5.

fields.name: roughness
fields.description: With power_law, the RMS deviation of a rough rim from a circle, in crater radii, drawn per crater.

fields.name: spectral_slope
fields.description: With power_law, the exponent s of the rim harmonics' amplitudes, falling as k^-s, drawn per crater; higher values leave less fine waviness.

fields.name: min_harmonic
fields.description: With power_law, the lowest harmonic of the rim's waviness. Must be from 1 to 64.

fields.name: max_harmonic
fields.description: With power_law, the highest harmonic of the rim's waviness; higher harmonics add finer wiggles. Must be from 1 to 64.

fields.name: elongated_share
fields.description: Share of eligible craters made elliptical, keeping their area. Must be from 0 to 1.

fields.name: ellipticity
fields.description: Long over short rim-to-rim diameter of elliptical craters, drawn per crater; at least 1.

fields.name: heading_deg
fields.description: Heading of elliptical craters' long axes, in degrees counter-clockwise from +x (local east on a body); unset gives random headings.

fields.name: heading_spread_deg
fields.description: Largest random turn of a long axis either way from the heading, in degrees. Must not be negative.

fields.name: marks_share
fields.description: Share of eligible craters given radial marks: ridges and grooves down the wall, strongest where it is steepest. Must be from 0 to 1.

fields.name: marks_amplitude
fields.description: Largest radial shift of the wall by the marks, in crater radii, drawn per crater; below marks_fade_radii / 3.75.

fields.name: marks_knots
fields.description: Random shifts around the crater the marks pass through; more knots give narrower marks. Must be from 3 to 1024.

fields.name: marks_inner_radii
fields.description: Distance from the center, in crater radii, where the marks reach full strength. Must be above 0 and below 1.

fields.name: marks_outer_radii
fields.description: Distance from the center, in crater radii, where the marks start to fade; at most 1 minus marks_fade_radii. Must be above 0 and below 1.

fields.name: marks_fade_radii
fields.description: Width, in crater radii, over which the marks fade in and out. Must be above 0 and at most 0.5.

fields.name: sigma_radii
fields.description: Deviation of the Gaussian the profile is smoothed with across distance, in crater radii; larger values round rims more, and 0 leaves them sharp. Must not be negative.

fields.name: inner_radii
fields.description: Inner edge of the smoothed band around the rim, in crater radii. Must be from 0 to below 1.

fields.name: outer_radii
fields.description: Outer edge of the smoothed band around the rim, in crater radii. Must be above 1.

fields.name: shape
fields.description: How the smoothing fades from full at the rim to none at the band's edges.

descriptions: Straight ramp: continuous, with kinks at both ends.
Cubic 3t^2 - 2t^3: continuous slope across the transition.
Quintic 6t^5 - 15t^4 + 10t^3: continuous slope and curvature, the smoothest join.
Gaussian falloff with sigma a third of the band, rescaled to end at zero.

fields.name: strength
fields.description: Share of the smoothed height used at the rim; lower values keep more of the sharp crest. Must be from 0 to 1.

fields.name: amplitude
fields.description: Amplitude of the noise over the whole footprint, as a share of the crater diameter; it fades out beyond the rim to the profile's reach, and 0 adds none. Must not be negative.

fields.name: wavelength_radii
fields.description: Wavelength of the footprint noise's first octave, in crater radii. Must be positive.

fields.name: octaves
fields.description: Octaves of both noises. Must be from 1 to 12.

fields.name: gain
fields.description: Weight ratio between successive octaves. Must be positive.

fields.name: rim_amplitude
fields.description: Amplitude of the extra noise in the band around the rim, as a share of the crater diameter; 0 adds none. Must not be negative.

fields.name: rim_wavelength_radii
fields.description: Wavelength of the rim noise's first octave, in crater radii. Must be positive.

fields.name: rim_inner_radii
fields.description: Inner edge of the rim noise band, in crater radii. Must be from 0 to below 1.

fields.name: rim_outer_radii
fields.description: Outer edge of the rim noise band, in crater radii. Must be above 1.

fields.name: seed
fields.description: Varies the noise of every crater; unset follows the layer's seed.

fields.name: wall_streaks
fields.description: Amplitude of the radial gullies down a fresh crater's inner wall, as a share of its diameter; 0 adds none. Must not be negative.

fields.name: wall_streak_width_radii
fields.description: Width of the gullies across the wall, in crater radii. Must be positive.

fields.name: ejecta
fields.description: Amplitude of the hummocky, radially lineated ejecta around a fresh crater, as a share of the ejecta's thickness (McGetchin et al. 1973); 0 adds none. Must not be negative.

fields.name: ejecta_lineation_radii
fields.description: Width of the ejecta's lineations across, in crater radii at the rim. Must be positive.

fields.name: mantling
fields.description: Share of older relief buried under the ejecta at the rim, falling with their thickness; needs a datum. Must be from 0 to 1.

fields.name: ejecta_reach_radii
fields.description: How far ejecta texture and burial reach, in crater radii. Must be above 1.

fields.name: min_freshness
fields.description: Freshness (depth over fresh depth) at or below which gullies and ejecta texture are worn away. Must be from 0 to below 1.

fields.name: seed
fields.description: Varies the texture of every crater; unset follows the layer's seed.

fields.name: asymmetric
fields.description: Shapes craters asymmetrically along the slope of the ground beneath the layer; off keeps them the same on any slope.

fields.name: seed
fields.description: Varies how far each crater's floor is offset; unset follows the layer's seed.

fields.name: floor_offset
fields.description: How far the deepest point lies downslope of the center, in diameters, drawn per crater; below 0.23.

fields.name: upslope_rim
fields.description: Share of the raised rim and ejecta kept straight upslope; the rest returns toward the sides. Must be from 0 to 1.

fields.name: full_slope_deg
fields.description: Slope at which the asymmetry is complete, in degrees; it rises from none on level ground. Must be positive.

fields.name: critical_gradient
fields.description: Critical gradient Sc, rise over run, toward which downslope transport grows without bound: a crater on a regional gradient S wears 1 / (1 - (S / Sc)^2) times as fast (Roering et al. 1999). Unset wears craters alike on any slope; no lunar value is published. Must be positive.

fields.name: max_wear_rate
fields.description: Fastest a slope makes craters wear, over level ground: a numerical cap as S nears Sc. Must be at least 1.

fields.name: enabled
fields.description: Steps the walls of large craters into slump terraces: benches and scarps between the floor and the rim crest.

fields.name: seed
fields.description: Varies each crater's benches, the arcs they cover and how they wander; unset follows the layer's seed.

fields.name: onset_diameter_m
fields.description: Smallest terraced crater, in meters; 20 km on the Moon, where half of fresh mare craters are terraced, and about 8 km on Mars. Must be positive.

fields.name: full_diameter_m
fields.description: Diameter in meters from which every crater has its most benches, over most of its wall; above the onset diameter. Must be positive.

fields.name: min_benches
fields.description: Benches at the onset diameter. Must be from 1 to 12.

fields.name: max_benches
fields.description: Benches from the full diameter; complex lunar craters usually have more than 3. Must be from 1 to 12.

fields.name: bench_slope_deg
fields.description: Slope of a bench, in degrees; mapped lunar terraces slope under 5 degrees. Must be above 0 and below 45 deg.

fields.name: scarp_share
fields.description: Least share of each step's width the scarps take; steeper steps give them more, and the bench takes the rest. Must be above 0 and below 1.

fields.name: scarp_slope_deg
fields.description: Slope the scarps rise at, in degrees, above the bench slope; each step gives its scarps the share of its width that keeps them near it. Must be above 0 and below 60 deg.

fields.name: arc_share
fields.description: Share of the wall's circumference each bench covers at the onset diameter; it rises to 0.9 at the full diameter, and 1 gives benches all the way round. Must be above 0 and at most 1.

fields.name: rim_variation
fields.description: How far the bench radii wander around the rim, in crater radii. Must not be negative.

fields.name: block_offset
fields.description: How far each slump block's headscarp steps from its neighbors', as a share of the room between scarps. Must be from 0 to 1.

fields.name: block_gaps
fields.description: Share of slump blocks missing from each bench, breaking the benches into segments. Must be from 0 to below 1.

fields.name: min_freshness
fields.description: Freshness, current over fresh depth, below which the terraces are gone; they soften as the crater wears down to it. Must be from 0 to below 1.

fields.name: enabled
fields.description: Builds the central peaks of complex craters from massifs: mountains clustered about the center in place of the profile's round dome.

fields.name: seed
fields.description: Varies each crater's massifs and their noise; unset follows the layer's seed.

fields.name: min_massifs
fields.description: Fewest massifs of a peak. Must be from 1 to 8.

fields.name: max_massifs
fields.description: Most massifs of a peak. Must be from 1 to 8.

fields.name: spread_radii
fields.description: How far the lesser massifs' centers scatter from the crater's center, in peak base radii. Must be from 0 to 2.

fields.name: elongation
fields.description: Most aspect ratio of a massif's footprint; 1 keeps them round, larger makes ridges. Must be from 1 to 4.

fields.name: chain_spread_deg
fields.description: Spread of the lesser massifs' bearings about a chain through the center, in degrees: about 70 strings them across the floor, wide spreads scatter them around it into stars and crosses. Must be from 0 to 360 deg.

fields.name: sharpness
fields.description: How sharp the massifs' crests are: 0 domes, 1 spires. Must be from 0 to 1.

fields.name: lopsidedness
fields.description: How far each massif's summit sits off its center toward one flank. Must be from 0 to 1.

fields.name: height_variation
fields.description: How much lower than the main massif the others may be, as a share of its height. Must be from 0 to 1.

fields.name: roughness
fields.description: Ridged noise over the massifs, as a share of their height, carving spurs, gullies and lesser summits; worn peaks lose it. Must be from 0 to 1.

fields.name: roughness_wavelength
fields.description: Wavelength of the massifs' noise, in peak base radii. Must be positive.

fields.name: warp
fields.description: How far the noise warps the massifs' outlines, in peak base radii. Must be from 0 to 0.3.

fields.name: height_scale
fields.description: The massifs' height over the profile's peak height. Must be above 0 and at most 4.

fields.name: width_scale
fields.description: The massifs' spread and size over the profile's peak base. Must be above 0 and at most 3.

fields.name: order
fields.description: Order in which overlapping craters are applied; later craters overprint earlier ones.

descriptions: Oldest craters first, then larger first: the physical order, so younger craters overprint older ones.
Largest craters first, then older first, so smaller craters overprint larger ones.

fields.name: fade_px
fields.description: How craters too small to resolve fade out, by output samples (pixels) across their diameter: absent up to the first count, whole from the second. Each must not be negative.

fields.name: fade_shape
fields.description: Curve of the fade between the two sample counts of fade_px.

descriptions: Straight ramp: continuous, with kinks at both ends.
Cubic 3t^2 - 2t^3: continuous slope across the transition.
Quintic 6t^5 - 15t^4 + 10t^3: continuous slope and curvature, the smoothest join.
Gaussian falloff with sigma a third of the band, rescaled to end at zero.

fields.name: datum
fields.description: Reference surface each crater's interior is cut relative to, fitted to the ground beneath it; none adds craters onto the terrain everywhere.

descriptions: No datum: the crater profile is added onto the terrain everywhere.
Interior cut relative to a least-squares plane over the fit footprint, keeping regional slopes.
Interior cut relative to a flat datum at the mean height over the fit footprint.
Interior cut relative to a flat datum at the terrain height under the crater center.

fields.name: datum_fit_radii
fields.description: Radius of the footprint the datum is fitted over, in crater radii. Must be positive.

fields.name: interior_replacement
fields.description: Share of the interior replaced by datum plus profile: 1 erases older relief inside the crater for a clean cut, 0 keeps it on the floor and walls. Must be from 0 to 1.

fields.name: blend
fields.description: Where and how a crater's replaced interior blends into the surrounding terrain.

fields.name: replacement
fields.description: How manual craters with replace set replace the terrain beneath them, whatever the datum: in full to start_radii, blending out to end_radii, on a plane fitted on a ring beyond.

fields.name: irregularity
fields.description: Irregular, non-circular crater outlines: which craters have them and how their shapes are drawn.

fields.name: rim_smoothing
fields.description: Rounded rims: each crater's profile smoothed across distance near its rim; off unless sigma_radii is set.

fields.name: noise
fields.description: Fractal noise over each crater's footprint and around its rim, keyed to the crater; off unless an amplitude is set.

fields.name: texture
fields.description: Gullies down fresh walls, textured ejecta and older relief buried under the ejecta; off unless an amplitude or mantling is set.

fields.name: slope
fields.description: Craters on sloping ground with floors offset downslope and rims lowered upslope; needs the plane datum.

fields.name: terraces
fields.description: Slump terraces on the walls of craters from the onset diameter, softening as they wear.

fields.name: peaks
fields.description: Central peaks of complex craters built from massifs, lowering as the craters wear.

fields.name: path
fields.description: GeoTIFF read in the surface's coordinates, relative to the configuration's folder: meters on a plane, longitude and latitude in degrees on a sphere. Empty uses value.

fields.name: value
fields.description: The field everywhere when no path is given.

fields.name: band
fields.description: Band of the GeoTIFF read, from 0.

fields.name: method
fields.description: How the raster is interpolated: nearest or bilinear, which stay within the cells read.

descriptions: The value of the nearest cell center: blocky, but never mixes values.
Linear in each axis over the four surrounding cells.
Keys cubic convolution (a = -0.5) over the sixteen surrounding cells: smooth, for upscaling DEMs.
Another name for cubic: the Catmull-Rom spline is the same kernel.
The three-lobe Lanczos kernel over the 36 surrounding cells: sharper than cubic, with slight ringing at steps.
The cubic B-spline over the sixteen surrounding cells: the smoothest, but it smooths the cells themselves.

fields.name: scale
fields.description: Multiplies every cell, such as 0.001 for a map stored in thousandths. Must be positive.

fields.name: fallback
fields.description: Value outside the raster and where its cells are no-data or NaN; unset leaves none, and the layer then keeps its own setting there.

fields.name: periodic_longitude
fields.description: The raster's x is longitude repeating every 360 degrees, so a map from 0 to 360 serves -180 to 180.

fields.name: field
fields.description: The map.

fields.name: measure
fields.description: What the map's values measure.

descriptions: The local density over the layer's own; 1 keeps it as the size distribution gives it.
Features with diameters in the map's range per area unit, such as boulders per km^2.
Share of the ground covered by features in the map's range, such as rock abundance.

fields.name: min_diameter_m
fields.description: Smallest diameter the map measures, in meters; positive for a count or areal fraction. Must not be negative.

fields.name: max_diameter_m
fields.description: Largest diameter the map measures, in meters, exclusive; unset for no limit. Must be positive.

fields.name: area_unit
fields.description: Square meters per area unit of a count: 1 for per m^2, 1e6 for per km^2. Must be positive.

fields.name: total
fields.description: The map counts every feature of its kind, including the secondaries thrown from a crater layer's craters and the boulders a layer throws out around craters, which are taken out of it first; off when it counts only what the layer generates.

fields.name: path
fields.description: Crater list of the coarser level, CSV or JSON as a crater_list output writes it (with attributes for the realized depths and rims), or a catalog of the craters a DEM holds; relative paths resolve against the configuration's folder. Required.

fields.name: min_source_px
fields.description: Source cells across from which a listed crater is stamped again sharp and generated craters are dropped; smaller ones are left to generation, which fills the gaps. Unset follows source_resolves_px; lower it to clean up the smaller craters a coarser run drew blurred into the source. Must be positive.

fields.name: max_source_px
fields.description: Source cells across from which listed craters are left as the source holds them, since interpolation barely softens them; unset stamps every one from min_source_px. Must be positive.

alternatives.description: Golombek and Rapp boulder sizes, set by the fraction of ground the boulders cover and the layer's qa and qb.
Blocks between craters from NASA SP-8023, the lunar surface design model (Figure 7).

fields.name: curve
fields.description: Which of the model's minimum, nominal and maximum curves to use, from fewest to most boulders.

descriptions: The model's minimum curve: the fewest boulders.
The model's nominal curve.
The model's maximum curve: the most boulders.

alternatives.description: Blocks around blocky craters from NASA SP-8023 (Figure 9), for the ejecta of craters that reached bedrock.

fields.name: curve
fields.description: Which of the model's minimum, nominal and maximum curves to use, from fewest to most boulders.

descriptions: The model's minimum curve: the fewest boulders.
The model's nominal curve.
The model's maximum curve: the most boulders.

alternatives.description: One of the power-law boulder distributions synthterrain offers, for comparison with it.

fields.name: model
fields.description: Which of synthterrain's power-law boulder distributions to use.

descriptions: 0.0001 D^-1.75457 per m^2 with D in meters: synthetic_moon's "low blockiness".
0.002 D^-2.6607 per m^2 with D in meters: synthetic_moon's "high blockiness".
0.0003 D^-2.482 per m^2 with D in meters: the VIPER Environmental Specification.

alternatives.description: A cumulative power law, N(>=D) = coefficient D^-exponent per m^2 with D in meters.

fields.name: coefficient
fields.description: Coefficient of N(>=D) = coefficient D^-exponent, the cumulative count per m^2 with D in meters; scales how many there are. Must be positive.

fields.name: exponent
fields.description: Exponent of the power law; larger values give relatively more small craters or boulders. Must be positive.

alternatives.description: A cumulative distribution made of power-law segments over diameter ranges.

fields.name: segments
fields.description: Power-law segments in strictly increasing order of start, each running to the next one's start; they must meet at their joins.

alternatives.description: A cumulative distribution from a table of diameters and counts N(>=D), in units you choose.

fields.name: diameters
fields.description: Table diameters in diameter units, strictly increasing; counts are interpolated linearly in log D and log N between them. Holds at least 2 items. Each must be positive.

fields.name: cumulative
fields.description: Cumulative count N(>=D) at each diameter, per area unit; not increasing. Each must be positive.

fields.name: diameter_unit
fields.description: Meters per table diameter unit: 1 for meters, 1000 for km. Must be positive.

fields.name: area_unit
fields.description: Square meters per table area unit: 1 for m^2, 1e6 for km^2. Must be positive.

alternatives.description: Counts per m^2 in diameter bands, each with diameters spread uniformly across it; none outside the bands.

fields.name: bands
fields.description: Diameter bands with their counts; overlapping bands add, and gaps between them hold none.

fields.name: total
fields.description: Count per m^2 of all bands together, shared in proportion to each band's density; 0 uses the densities as given. Must not be negative.

fields.name: spread
fields.description: Boulder abundance varies from 1 / spread to spread times its mean; 1 is the same everywhere. Must be at least 1.

fields.name: size_m
fields.description: Typical width of a patch of richer or poorer boulder cover, in meters. Must be positive.

fields.name: share
fields.description: Share of the boulders between craters gathered in clusters; 0 leaves them scattered. Must be from 0 to 1.

fields.name: center_spacing_m
fields.description: Typical distance between cluster centers, in meters; with thomas, one center per spacing squared on average. Must be positive.

fields.name: radius_m
fields.description: Gaussian radius of a cluster, in meters; below the spacing with nearest, at most twice it with thomas. Must be positive.

fields.name: model
fields.description: How cluster centers are laid out and their clusters combine.

descriptions: One center per cell of a jittered lattice, each point weighted by its nearest center only.
A Thomas cluster process: Poisson-scattered centers whose Gaussian clusters add where they overlap.

fields.name: min_crater_diameter_m
fields.description: Smallest crater, in meters, that throws blocks out; unset with no regolith thickness, no crater throws blocks. Must not be negative.

fields.name: regolith_thickness_m
fields.description: Regolith thickness in meters: craters smaller than it over the excavation depth ratio dig no boulder and throw no blocks. Unset ignores the regolith. Must be positive.

fields.name: excavation_depth_ratio
fields.description: Depth of excavation over crater diameter; with the regolith thickness it sets the smallest crater that throws blocks. Must be above 0 and at most 1.

fields.name: coverage
fields.description: Golombek-Rapp k, the fraction of ground covered by blocks at the rim of a fresh crater; unset is 0.1. Only golombek_rapp ejecta sizes use it, so set it only with them. Must be above 0 and below 1.

fields.name: profile
fields.description: How the share of a crater's blocks falls off with distance from its center.

descriptions: Every block inside the rim, falling along a smoothstep to none at the reach.
Exponential decay outside the rim, a fixed share on the floor and none beyond the reach: synthterrain's crater probability map.

fields.name: reach
fields.description: Distance from the crater's center, in crater radii, beyond which it adds no blocks. Must be above 1.

fields.name: decay_radii
fields.description: With the exponential profile, the e-folding distance of the blocks outside the rim, in crater radii. Must be positive.

fields.name: floor_share
fields.description: With the exponential profile, the crater floor's share of the rim's blocks. Must be from 0 to 1.

fields.name: aging
fields.description: How a crater's blocks wear away with time, so that few are left around old craters.

descriptions: Blocks wear away with the crater's freshness (current over fresh depth): all when fresh, none at or below the minimum freshness.
Blocks wear away with the crater's age as (1 - age / lifetime)^exponent, synthterrain's form.

fields.name: min_freshness
fields.description: With freshness aging, the freshness (current over fresh depth) at or below which a crater keeps no blocks. Must be from 0 to below 1.

fields.name: lifetime_gyr
fields.description: With age aging, the crater age in Gyr at which a crater keeps no blocks. Must be positive.

fields.name: aging_exponent
fields.description: With age aging, the exponent of (1 - age / lifetime); higher values strip blocks from craters sooner. Must not be negative.

fields.name: gravity
fields.description: Surface gravity in m/s^2: with the regolith thickness, it limits how far blocks are thrown, after Bart and Melosh (2010). Unset applies no such limit. Must be positive.

fields.name: reach_m
fields.description: Distance in meters around a point at which its surroundings are read, to tell rises from lows. Must be positive.

fields.name: rise_soil
fields.description: Height above the surroundings, as a share of the reach, at or below which the ground is soil.

fields.name: rise_boulder
fields.description: Height above the surroundings, as a share of the reach, at or above which the ground is bedrock; above the soil threshold.

fields.name: slope_soil
fields.description: Slope, as rise over run, at or under which soil holds.

fields.name: slope_boulder
fields.description: Slope, as rise over run, at or over which no soil holds and the ground is bedrock; above the soil threshold.

fields.name: floor_cover
fields.description: Share of level ground that is bedrock too, in noise patches, as on a swept lava floor; 0 for none. Must be from 0 to below 1.

fields.name: floor_patch_m
fields.description: Width of the bedrock patches on level ground, in meters. Must be positive.

fields.name: seed
fields.description: Seed of the bedrock patches on level ground.

fields.name: height_share
fields.description: Height of the regolith piled against a boulder, as a share of its exposed height; 0 draws no fillets. Must be from 0 to 1.

fields.name: width_ratio
fields.description: How far the fillet reaches beyond the boulder's edge, over its diameter; it falls to nothing there. Must be positive.

fields.name: share
fields.description: Share of boulders with a windward facet planed by sand-laden wind; 0 for none. Gale crater: 0.39 (Bridges et al. 2014). Must be from 0 to 1.

fields.name: wind_azimuth_deg
fields.description: Direction the abrading wind blows toward, in degrees counter-clockwise from +x (local east on a body); facets face the other way.

fields.name: min_angle_deg
fields.description: Gentlest facet slope from horizontal, in degrees; 50 to 60 on basalt (Laity and Bridges 2009). Must be above 0 and below 90 deg.

fields.name: max_angle_deg
fields.description: Steepest facet slope from horizontal, in degrees. Must be above 0 and below 90 deg.

fields.name: second_wind_azimuth_deg
fields.description: A second abrading wind, where it blows toward, in degrees like the first; some faceted boulders get a second facet facing it and a keel between. Unset for none.

fields.name: keel_share
fields.description: Share of faceted boulders with the second facet. Gale crater: 12 of 39 (Bridges et al. 2014). Must be from 0 to 1.

fields.name: min_diameter_m
fields.description: Smallest boulder that breaks, in meters. Must be positive.

fields.name: split_wear
fields.description: Wear from 0 (fresh) to 1 from which boulders split into pieces that still fit; 0.5 by default. Must be from 0 to 1.

fields.name: rubble_wear
fields.description: Wear from which the pieces scatter as rubble, turn and sink; at least split_wear. Must be from 0 to 1.

fields.name: min_pieces
fields.description: Fewest pieces a boulder breaks into. Must be from 2 to 12.

fields.name: max_pieces
fields.description: Most pieces a boulder breaks into. Must be from 2 to 12.

fields.name: gap_ratio
fields.description: Widest crack between split pieces, as a share of the boulder's diameter. Must not be negative.

fields.name: spread_ratio
fields.description: How far rubble scatters beyond the cracks, as a share of the boulder's diameter. Must not be negative.

fields.name: slab_share
fields.description: Share of broken boulders split by roughly parallel cracks right through them; the rest crack out from the middle. Must be from 0 to 1.

fields.name: min_diameter_m
fields.description: Boulders at least this many meters across become 3D models; unset applies no diameter threshold. Must be positive.

fields.name: min_px
fields.description: Boulders spanning at least this many samples at the spacing evaluated become 3D models, so finer levels of detail make more of them; unset applies no such threshold. Must be positive.

fields.name: max_diameter_m
fields.description: Boulders this many meters across or wider are not models, keeping a band of sizes as models; unset applies no upper limit. Must be positive.

fields.name: max_px
fields.description: Boulders spanning this many samples or more are not models; unset applies no such limit. Must be positive.

fields.name: min_diameter_m
fields.description: Smallest boulder drawn into the heights, in meters; smaller ones stay in the lists only, for the renderer's surface detail. Must not be negative.

fields.name: max_diameter_m
fields.description: Boulders this many meters across or wider are not drawn into the heights; unset applies no upper limit. Must be positive.

fields.name: include_models
fields.description: Draws the 3D model boulders into the heights as well, as a stand-in for far views.

fields.name: min
fields.description: Lower end of the interval the value is drawn uniformly from.

fields.name: max
fields.description: Upper end of the interval the value is drawn uniformly from.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Label of the style, for reference; it does not change the shapes.

fields.name: weight
fields.description: Relative share of boulders given this style; the styles' weights must not all be 0. Must not be negative.

fields.name: solid
fields.description: Solid the shape starts from, before it is stretched, rounded, roughened and fractured.

descriptions: Boulders start from an icosahedron, twenty triangles on the unit sphere: rounder shapes.
Boulders start from a cube: blocky shapes.
Boulders start from a square-based pyramid.
Boulders start from a triangular prism, a wedge.
Boulders start from a regular tetrahedron: angular shapes.

fields.name: intermediate
fields.description: Range of the intermediate axis over the long one, b / a, within (0, 1]; lower values give more elongated boulders.

fields.name: short_axis
fields.description: Range of the short, vertical axis over the long one, c / a, within (0, 1] and at most the intermediate ratio; lower values give flatter boulders.

fields.name: rounding
fields.description: Range of the share, from 0 to 1, by which the shape is rounded toward the ellipsoid of its axes: 0 keeps the solid's edges and corners, 1 is the ellipsoid.

fields.name: min_fractures
fields.description: Fewest flat fracture planes cutting a boulder; each boulder's count is drawn between the two. Must be from 0 to 64.

fields.name: max_fractures
fields.description: Most flat fracture planes cutting a boulder; at least the fewest. Must be from 0 to 64.

fields.name: fracture_depth
fields.description: Range of where each fracture plane lies, as a share of the shape's reach along its normal, within (0, 1]; lower values cut more away.

fields.name: max_fracture_tilt
fields.description: Largest vertical component of a fracture plane's unit normal: 0 keeps normals horizontal, cutting a slab about its rim only. Must be from 0 to 1.

fields.name: noise_amplitude
fields.description: Largest relative change of the radius by the roughening noise; 0 leaves the surface unroughened. Must be from 0 to below 1.

fields.name: noise_wavelength
fields.description: Wavelength of the roughening noise's first octave, in long-axis lengths; smaller values give finer bumps. Must be positive.

fields.name: noise_octaves
fields.description: Octaves of the roughening noise, each halving in wavelength; more add finer detail. Must be from 1 to 12.

fields.name: edge_softness
fields.description: Range of how far edges and corners are worn back where faces meet, as weathering rounds them, in long-axis lengths from 0 to 0.5; 0 keeps them sharp.

fields.name: face_roughness
fields.description: How far fracture faces undulate, as a share of each plane's offset; 0 keeps them flat. Must be from 0 to 0.5.

fields.name: styles
fields.description: Kinds of boulder each shape is drawn from, picked by weight. Holds at least 1 item.

fields.name: subdivisions
fields.description: Times the solid's triangles are split in four; more give finer, smoother shapes with more triangles. Must be from 0 to 6.

fields.name: weathering
fields.description: Scales every style's edge softness: 0 gives sharp edges, 1 the styles' own, more is more worn. Must not be negative.

fields.name: seed
fields.description: Seed the shapes are drawn with, along with each shape's own seed; changing it reshapes every boulder.

fields.name: field
fields.description: The map.

fields.name: measure
fields.description: What the map's values measure.

descriptions: The cumulative exponent alpha, counts falling as D^-alpha.
The mean diameter in meters of the features from the reference diameter up, from which alpha = mean / (mean - D0).

fields.name: reference_diameter_m
fields.description: Diameter D0 in meters where the local power law meets the layer's own count, as N(>=D) = N(>=D0) (D / D0)^-alpha; for a mean diameter map, the smallest diameter averaged. Must be positive.

fields.name: min_exponent
fields.description: Smallest exponent alpha the map's values are clamped to; with the largest it bounds the boulders drawn, so generous bounds draw more to thin. Must be positive.

fields.name: max_exponent
fields.description: Largest exponent alpha the map's values are clamped to; above the smallest. Must be positive.

fields.name: x
fields.description: Center along x in the surface's coordinates; the longitude in degrees on a sphere.

fields.name: y
fields.description: Center along y in the surface's coordinates; the latitude in degrees on a sphere.

fields.name: diameter_m
fields.description: Length of the long axis, in meters. Must be positive.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Stable ID that seeds what is drawn for the boulder; unset derives one from its position and diameter.

fields.name: height_m
fields.description: Vertical extent in meters, buried part included; unset draws it from the height ratios. Must be positive.

fields.name: burial
fields.description: Buried share of the height; unset draws it. Must be from 0 to below 1.

fields.name: yaw_deg
fields.description: Rotation about the vertical, degrees counter-clockwise from east; unset draws it.

fields.name: lean_deg
fields.description: Tilt of the boulder's vertical axis from the vertical, degrees; unset draws it.

fields.name: tilt_deg
fields.description: Angle of the up axis from the vertical after lean, degrees; unset draws it. A followed slope tips it further.

fields.name: tilt_azimuth_deg
fields.description: Direction the up axis tips toward, degrees counter-clockwise from east; unset draws it.

fields.name: wear
fields.description: How worn it is, 0 fresh; unset draws it. With burial_by_wear it sets a drawn burial. Must be from 0 to 1.

fields.name: model
fields.description: Whether it is a 3D model rather than relief in the heights; unset follows the layer's model threshold.

fields.name: rest
fields.description: Which axis it stands along; unset draws it. A fixed lean, tilt, tilt azimuth or rest keeps a model from being tipped over by settle.

descriptions: On its broadest face: its short axis up.
On a side: its intermediate axis up.
On an end: its long axis up.

fields.name: shape_seed
fields.description: Seed of its 3D shape, as a generated boulder's derived one; unset derives it from the ID.

alternatives.description: An axis-aligned rectangle in the surface's coordinates: meters on a plane, longitude and latitude in degrees on a body.

fields.name: min_x
fields.description: Lower edge along x.

fields.name: min_y
fields.description: Lower edge along y.

fields.name: max_x
fields.description: Upper edge along x; above min_x.

fields.name: max_y
fields.description: Upper edge along y; above min_y.

alternatives.description: A circle in the surface's coordinates, its radius in meters.

fields.name: x
fields.description: Center along x in the surface's coordinates; the longitude in degrees on a sphere.

fields.name: y
fields.description: Center along y in the surface's coordinates; the latitude in degrees on a sphere.

fields.name: radius_m
fields.description: Radius of the circle in meters, also on a sphere. Must not be negative.

alternatives.description: A simple polygon in the surface's coordinates, concave or with holes: to follow a mapped unit or a traverse corridor.

fields.name: points
fields.description: Vertices of the outline as [x, y] pairs in the surface's coordinates, closed from the last back to the first; points inside an odd number of outlines and holes are inside. Holds at least 3 items.

fields.name: holes
fields.description: Outlines cut out of the polygon, each a list of at least 3 [x, y] vertices as `points`; the masked layer fades out from their edges as from the outline's.

fields.name: seed
fields.description: Seed of the rays' directions; layers with the same layout share the same rays.

fields.name: count
fields.description: Number of rays of a crater, drawn per crater and rounded; from 0 to 64.

fields.name: width_deg
fields.description: Angle in degrees a ray spans 2 radii from the center, drawn per ray, within (0, 180).

fields.name: enabled
fields.description: Gathers secondaries into their primary's rays and clumps them along each ray, as radial chains and clusters; off spreads them evenly.

fields.name: layout
fields.description: The rays; give a crater albedo layer's rays the same layout for bright rays over the secondaries.

fields.name: share
fields.description: Share of secondaries in rays; the rest stay spread evenly. Illustrative. Must be from 0 to 1.

fields.name: min_half_angle_deg
fields.description: Narrowest half width of a ray, in degrees, so rays widen with range beyond their width near the primary. Illustrative. Must be above 0 and below 90 deg.

fields.name: clustering
fields.description: How strongly secondaries clump along a ray: 0 spreads them evenly along it, 1 puts them only in clumps. Illustrative. Must be from 0 to 1.

fields.name: cluster_spacing
fields.description: Typical spacing of clumps along a ray, in natural log of range; smaller values give shorter, more frequent clumps. Illustrative. Must be positive.

fields.name: elongated_share
fields.description: Share of secondaries stretched along the line back to their primary; 0 keeps them round. Must be from 0 to 1.

fields.name: ellipticity
fields.description: Long over short axis of an elongated secondary near the primary, drawn per secondary; at least 1, falling to 1 at the outer range.

fields.name: wavelength_m
fields.description: Crest-to-crest spacing of the ripples on flat sand, in meters. Must be positive.

fields.name: height_m
fields.description: Trough-to-crest height of the ripples on flat sand, in meters. Must not be negative.

fields.name: lee_fraction
fields.description: Share of a ripple wavelength the lee face takes: 0.5 is symmetric, lower values give a steeper lee face. Must be above 0 and below 1.

fields.name: sinuosity
fields.description: How far a ripple crest wanders along its length, in wavelengths. Must not be negative.

fields.name: slope_coupling
fields.description: How strongly the dune's slope turns and tightens the ripples: they shorten on steep lee faces and turn on the flanks; 0 keeps them straight across the wind. Must not be negative.

fields.name: interdune_cover
fields.description: Share of the ripple height kept on the ground between dunes. Must be from 0 to 1.

fields.name: defect_density
fields.description: Forked crests (Y-junctions): pairs of crest ends per meter of crest, as measured on dune fields (Ewing et al. 2010); 0 for none. Mars large ripples: 0.099. Must not be negative.

fields.name: flank_straightening
fields.description: How far crests straighten off the stoss: 1 keeps the sinuosity on flat sand and stoss slopes and takes it away on flanks and lee slopes, as Martian large ripples do. Must be from 0 to 1.

fields.name: fade_px
fields.description: How ripples too fine for the sample spacing fade out, by samples per wavelength. Each must not be negative.

fields.name: fade_shape
fields.description: Curve of the fade between the two sample counts of fade_px.

descriptions: Straight ramp: continuous, with kinks at both ends.
Cubic 3t^2 - 2t^3: continuous slope across the transition.
Quintic 6t^5 - 15t^4 + 10t^3: continuous slope and curvature, the smoothest join.
Gaussian falloff with sigma a third of the band, rescaled to end at zero.

fields.name: cover
fields.description: Chance that each lattice cell of the slip faces holds a grainflow. Must be from 0 to 1.

fields.name: min_scarp_width_m
fields.description: Narrowest scarp, in meters. Must be positive.

fields.name: max_scarp_width_m
fields.description: Widest scarp, in meters. Must be positive.

fields.name: min_scarp_length_m
fields.description: Shortest scarp downslope, in meters. Must be positive.

fields.name: max_scarp_length_m
fields.description: Longest scarp downslope, in meters. Must be positive.

fields.name: min_lobe_width_m
fields.description: Narrowest lobe, in meters. Must be positive.

fields.name: max_lobe_width_m
fields.description: Widest lobe, in meters. Must be positive.

fields.name: min_lobe_length_m
fields.description: Shortest lobe downslope, in meters. Must be positive.

fields.name: max_lobe_length_m
fields.description: Longest lobe downslope, in meters. Must be positive.

fields.name: thickness_m
fields.description: Depth of a scarp and height of a lobe, in meters. Must not be negative.

fields.name: fade_px
fields.description: How grainflows too narrow for the sample spacing fade out, by samples across a lobe. Each must not be negative.

fields.name: fade_shape
fields.description: Curve of the fade between the two sample counts of fade_px.

descriptions: Straight ramp: continuous, with kinks at both ends.
Cubic 3t^2 - 2t^3: continuous slope across the transition.
Quintic 6t^5 - 15t^4 + 10t^3: continuous slope and curvature, the smoothest join.
Gaussian falloff with sigma a third of the band, rescaled to end at zero.

alternatives.description: A stack of fractal noise layers added to the terrain, for hills, ridges and rolling relief.

fields.name: stack
fields.description: Noise layers, combined in order: the first enabled layer sets the height and each later one is combined with it by its blend mode. Holds 1 to 8 items.

fields.name: estimate_from_source
fields.description: Takes each layer's unset hurst and amplitude from the source's variogram, continued to the layer's wavelength; for wavelengths at or below the source's cell size. Needs a source with posts.

fields.name: source_resolves_px
fields.description: Source cells across from which the source's data already holds the noise layers of the stack, by their wavelength, the longest of each layer's octaves: only smaller ones are added, each raster of a chain giving its own limit. Ignored on synthetic sources and where no raster has data; null adds them all. Must be positive.

alternatives.description: Impact craters generated from a density and age model, or placed by hand, and cut into the terrain.

fields.name: morphometry
fields.description: Published fits of fresh crater depth, rim height and complex crater shape the craters are shaped with.

descriptions: Fresh lunar craters: Fassett et al. (2022) depth and rim height below 15 km, Pike's (1977) complex crater fits above.
Fresh Martian craters: depth and rim height capped for small craters, Garvin et al.'s (2003) fits for large and complex craters from 7 km.

fields.name: generate_random
fields.description: Draws random craters from the size distribution; off places only the manual craters.

fields.name: seed
fields.description: Seed the craters are generated with; changing it gives a different crater field of the same statistics.

fields.name: density
fields.description: Size-frequency distribution of the generated craters: how many of each diameter per unit area.

fields.name: ages
fields.description: How generated craters are given ages, which the degradation model wears them down by; unset gives steady-state ages on the density's production surface and equilibrium.

fields.name: min_diameter_m
fields.description: Smallest crater generated, in meters; lower values add many more small craters. Must be positive.

fields.name: max_diameter_m
fields.description: Largest crater generated, in meters; above the smallest. Must be positive.

fields.name: spacing
fields.description: Keeps craters of similar size apart by removing conflicting ones, which lowers the density below the model's.

fields.name: max_craters
fields.description: Most generated craters kept, the largest first; unset keeps all. Manual craters are always kept, and a cap means tiles no longer match the whole grid.

fields.name: manual
fields.description: Craters placed by hand in the surface's coordinates, added to any generated ones.

fields.name: profile
fields.description: Shape of a fresh crater's cross-section, scaled to each crater's diameter.

fields.name: degradation
fields.description: How craters wear down from their fresh shape with age.

fields.name: apply
fields.description: How craters are cut into the terrain: their order, datum, blending, fading and irregular outlines.

fields.name: density_map
fields.description: Map that sets the crater density point by point, scaling the density's size distribution to what it measures; unset keeps the density the same everywhere.

fields.name: completeness
fields.description: Where the manual craters are a complete catalog: the diameter in meters from which they stand in for generated craters, infinite or no value where there is no catalog. Unset keeps every generated crater.

fields.name: source_resolves_px
fields.description: Source cells across from which the source's data already holds the craters (the smaller of this and completeness when both are set), by their diameter: only smaller ones are added, each raster of a chain giving its own limit. Ignored on synthetic sources and where no raster has data; null adds them all. Must be positive.

fields.name: replace_inherited_craters
fields.description: Craters of a coarser level, such as a coarser run whose heights are the source, stamped again sharp with their IDs, ages, depths and rims where the source's upsampling softened them; null for none.

alternatives.description: Boulders scattered over the ground from a size distribution, in patches and around fresh craters, as relief or 3D models.

fields.name: generate_random
fields.description: Draws random boulders from the size distribution, between craters and around them; off places only the manual boulders, and the sizes, coverage and ejecta go unused.

fields.name: coverage
fields.description: Golombek-Rapp k, the fraction of the ground covered by boulders, above 0 when generating random boulders; higher values give more boulders. Unset is 0.02. Only golombek_rapp sizes use it, so set it only with them. Must be from 0 to below 1.

fields.name: qa
fields.description: Constant term of the Golombek-Rapp q = qa + qb / k, per meter; a larger q leaves fewer large boulders. Unset is 1.79. Only golombek_rapp sizes or ejecta sizes use it, so set it only with them.

fields.name: qb
fields.description: Term of the Golombek-Rapp q = qa + qb / k divided by the coverage k, per meter; unset is 0.152, and it is used as qa is.

fields.name: min_diameter_m
fields.description: Smallest boulder generated, in meters; lower values add many more small boulders. Must be positive.

fields.name: max_diameter_m
fields.description: Largest boulder generated, in meters, exclusive; above the smallest. Must be positive.

fields.name: sizes
fields.description: Size distribution of the boulders between craters, per m^2; patches and bedrock scale its density.

fields.name: seed
fields.description: Seed of the boulders, their attributes and the patches; changing it gives a different boulder field of the same statistics.

fields.name: patches
fields.description: Patches of richer and poorer boulder cover across the ground.

fields.name: clusters
fields.description: Clusters of the boulders between craters around scattered centers; off unless share is set.

fields.name: ejecta
fields.description: Blocks thrown out by craters of every top-level crater layer before this one that dug into boulder, densest at the rim and thinning outward; none with generate_random off.

fields.name: ejecta_sizes
fields.description: Size distribution of the blocks at the rim of a fresh crater, per m^2; golombek_rapp uses the ejecta's coverage with qa and qb. Unset follows sizes.

fields.name: extrapolate
