fields.description: Lets the size distributions be evaluated outside their valid diameters, such as beyond a table's published ones; otherwise they must cover the boulder sizes.

fields.name: exposure
fields.description: Raises the abundance of boulders where the ground beneath is bedrock, judged from its shape; unset disables it.

fields.name: bedrock_abundance
fields.description: Boulder abundance on bedrock over that on soil, and in between in proportion; used with the exposure field. Must be positive.

fields.name: bedrock_mean_size_m
fields.description: With a density map, the side in meters of the squares bedrock is held to the map's mean over, so it gathers boulders without adding any; a GeoTIFF map uses its own cells. Must be positive.

fields.name: min_height_ratio
fields.description: Smallest boulder height over diameter; each boulder's is drawn uniformly between the two ratios. Must be positive.

fields.name: max_height_ratio
fields.description: Largest boulder height over diameter; at least the smallest. Must be positive.

fields.name: min_burial
fields.description: Smallest buried share of a boulder's height; each boulder's is drawn uniformly between the two shares. Must be from 0 to below 1.

fields.name: max_burial
fields.description: Largest buried share of a boulder's height; more burial leaves less of the boulder exposed. Must be from 0 to below 1.

fields.name: max_lean_deg
fields.description: Largest tilt of a boulder from the vertical, in degrees. Must not be negative.

fields.name: side_share
fields.description: Share of boulders resting on a side, their intermediate axis up, rather than on their broadest face. Must be from 0 to 1.

fields.name: end_share
fields.description: Share of boulders standing on an end, their long axis up; with side_share, at most 1. Must be from 0 to 1.

fields.name: max_tilt_deg
fields.description: Largest tilt of a boulder's up axis from the vertical in a random direction, after its lean, in degrees; tilts are spread evenly over that cap of directions. Must be from 0 to 180 deg.

fields.name: follow_slope
fields.description: Settles each boulder on the slope of the ground beneath it before its tilt.

fields.name: settle
fields.description: Tips each boulder model over until it rests stably on a face, its center of mass over what it stands on, rather than balanced on an edge or corner.

fields.name: max_slope_deg
fields.description: Steepest ground, across a boulder's diameter, that boulders stay on, in degrees; steeper ground has none, models and drawn boulders alike. Unset keeps boulders on any slope. Must be above 0 and below 90 deg.

fields.name: roll_distance_m
fields.description: With max_slope_deg, boulders on steeper ground roll down it and rest where it is gentle enough, gathering at the foot of slopes; those that would roll farther than this many meters are left out. Unset leaves out every boulder on steeper ground. Must be positive.

fields.name: burial_by_wear
fields.description: How far wear sets burial: blocks of fresh craters sit near the smallest burial and those of worn ones sink toward the largest, while boulders between craters span every stage; 0 draws burial uniformly. Must be from 0 to 1.

fields.name: fillet
fields.description: Regolith piled against each boulder's base, around relief and models alike; off unless height_share is set.

fields.name: ventifacts
fields.description: Windward facets planed on boulders by sand-laden wind, from wear; off unless share is set.

fields.name: fragmentation
fields.description: Boulders broken by wear into pieces that replace them, split and then scattered as rubble; leave it out for none to break.

fields.name: relief
fields.description: How the boulders drawn into the heights look there.

descriptions: Each boulder's exposed part drawn as a dome: cheap, and enough for small boulders.
The top surface of each boulder's 3D boulder shape drawn into the heights.
No rock relief in the heights, only fillets when set, for programs that place every boulder as a model of its own.

fields.name: model_threshold
fields.description: Which boulders become 3D models of their own rather than relief in the heights; neither threshold set means no models.

fields.name: relief_range
fields.description: Which boulders are drawn into the heights by diameter: none below min_diameter_m or from max_diameter_m, and models only when asked.

fields.name: shapes
fields.description: The boulders' 3D boulder shapes, used by shape relief and by models.

fields.name: shape_files
fields.description: Rock meshes (.obj with its .mtl, .gltf or .glb) the boulder shapes are drawn from instead of the procedural styles, each boulder picking one by its shape seed; paths relative to the configuration. Empty keeps the procedural shapes.

fields.name: density_map
fields.description: Map that sets the abundance of boulders between craters point by point, scaling the sizes to what it measures; unset keeps the abundance the sizes set everywhere.

fields.name: slope_map
fields.description: Map of how steeply boulder counts fall with size, such as a mean diameter map, bending the sizes into a local power law through their count at its reference diameter; needs a size distribution. Unset keeps the sizes' shape everywhere.

fields.name: manual
fields.description: Catalog or hand-placed boulders placed as given and never thinned or left out; fields left unset are drawn as for generated boulders. Boulders fixing any field never break.

fields.name: completeness
fields.description: Where the manual boulders are a complete catalog: the diameter in meters from which they stand in for generated boulders, infinite or no value where there is no catalog. Unset keeps every generated boulder.

fields.name: shape_prototypes
fields.description: How many shapes the boulders share, so they can be drawn as instances; 0 gives every boulder a shape of its own.

fields.name: ground_spacing_m
fields.description: Spacing in meters at which the layer reads the ground beneath it, for the exposure field, placement, settling, slopes and breaking; fixed so that which boulders exist does not depend on the level of detail. Must be positive.

fields.name: fade_px
fields.description: Which boulders are drawn into the heightmap by their size in output samples (pixels): the first count is the smallest drawn (2 by default, the fewest that resolve a boulder) and the second the size from which they are drawn in full. Smaller boulders exist only in the boulder lists and 3D models. Each must not be negative.

fields.name: fade_shape
fields.description: Curve of the fade between the two sample counts of fade_px.

descriptions: Straight ramp: continuous, with kinks at both ends.
Cubic 3t^2 - 2t^3: continuous slope across the transition.
Quintic 6t^5 - 15t^4 + 10t^3: continuous slope and curvature, the smoothest join.
Gaussian falloff with sigma a third of the band, rescaled to end at zero.

fields.name: source_resolves_px
fields.description: Source cells across from which the source's data already holds the boulders (the smaller of this and completeness when both are set), by their diameter: only smaller ones are added, each raster of a chain giving its own limit. Ignored on synthetic sources and where no raster has data; null adds them all. Must be positive.

alternatives.description: Fine roughness from octaves of noise, scaled to a given RMS slope over a baseline.

fields.name: rms_slope
fields.description: RMS slope, as rise over run, over the baseline when every octave is resolved; higher values give rougher ground. Unset is 0.15, or with estimate_from_source the source's RMS slope extrapolated to the baseline. Must be positive.

fields.name: baseline_m
fields.description: Baseline the RMS slope is given over, in meters. Must be positive.

fields.name: hurst
fields.description: Hurst exponent: octave amplitudes grow as wavelength^hurst, so lower values put relatively more roughness at short wavelengths. Unset is 0.8, or with estimate_from_source the source's. Must be above 0 and at most 1.

fields.name: estimate_from_source
fields.description: Fits unset rms_slope and hurst to the source's variogram at lags of 1 to 8 cells and continues it to the baseline; keep max_wavelength_m near the source's cell size. Needs a source with posts.

fields.name: max_wavelength_m
fields.description: Wavelength of the longest octave, in meters. Must be positive.

fields.name: min_wavelength_m
fields.description: Wavelength of the shortest octave, in meters; octaves halve from the longest down to it, spanning at most 40 octaves. Must be positive.

fields.name: seed
fields.description: Seed of the noise; changing it gives a different pattern of the same roughness.

fields.name: fade_px
fields.description: How octaves too fine to resolve at the sample spacing fade out, by samples per wavelength. Each must not be negative.

fields.name: fade_shape
fields.description: Curve of the fade between the two sample counts of fade_px.

descriptions: Straight ramp: continuous, with kinks at both ends.
Cubic 3t^2 - 2t^3: continuous slope across the transition.
Quintic 6t^5 - 15t^4 + 10t^3: continuous slope and curvature, the smoothest join.
Gaussian falloff with sigma a third of the band, rescaled to end at zero.

alternatives.description: Fields of wind-blown ripples or dunes added to the terrain.

fields.name: wavelength_m
fields.description: Crest-to-crest spacing, in meters; each field's varies from 0.8 to 1.2 times it. Must be positive.

fields.name: height_m
fields.description: Trough-to-crest height, in meters, scaled with each field's wavelength. Must not be negative.

fields.name: wind_azimuth_deg
fields.description: Direction the wind blows toward, in degrees counter-clockwise from +x (local east on a body); crests lie across it.

fields.name: azimuth_spread_deg
fields.description: Largest difference of each field's wind from the azimuth, in degrees. Must not be negative.

fields.name: lee_fraction
fields.description: Share of a wavelength the lee face takes: 0.5 is symmetric, lower values give a steeper lee face. Must be above 0 and below 1.

fields.name: sinuosity
fields.description: How far a crest wanders along its length, in wavelengths; 0 gives straight crests. Must not be negative.

fields.name: cover
fields.description: Share of the ground under bedform fields; 0 gives no bedforms. Must be from 0 to 0.9.

fields.name: field_size_m
fields.description: Typical width of a bedform field, in meters. Must be positive.

fields.name: seed
fields.description: Seed of the fields and their crests; changing it gives a different layout of the same statistics.

fields.name: exposure
fields.description: Leaves out fields whose centers lie on bedrock, the likelier the barer the ground, as sand settles in lows; unset disables it.

fields.name: exposure_spacing_m
fields.description: Spacing in meters the ground is read at for the exposure field. Must be positive.

fields.name: fade_px
fields.description: How bedforms too fine for the sample spacing fade out, by samples per wavelength. Each must not be negative.

fields.name: fade_shape
fields.description: Curve of the fade between the two sample counts of fade_px.

descriptions: Straight ramp: continuous, with kinks at both ends.
Cubic 3t^2 - 2t^3: continuous slope across the transition.
Quintic 6t^5 - 15t^4 + 10t^3: continuous slope and curvature, the smoothest join.
Gaussian falloff with sigma a third of the band, rescaled to end at zero.

fields.name: source_resolves_px
fields.description: Source cells across from which the source's data already holds the bedforms, by their wavelength: only smaller ones are added, each raster of a chain giving its own limit. Ignored on synthetic sources and where no raster has data; null adds them all. Must be positive.

alternatives.description: Scales and shifts the heights so far, for vertical exaggeration or a datum shift.

fields.name: scale
fields.description: Factor every height so far is multiplied by, as for vertical exaggeration.

fields.name: offset_m
fields.description: Meters added to every height after scaling, to shift the datum.

alternatives.description: Clamps the heights so far between optional bounds, to flatten a basin floor or cap peaks.

fields.name: min_m
fields.description: Lowest height kept, in meters; lower heights are raised to it, flattening basin floors. Unset leaves heights unbounded below.

fields.name: max_m
fields.description: Highest height kept, in meters; higher heights are lowered to it, capping peaks. Unset leaves heights unbounded above.

alternatives.description: Another layer applied only inside a rectangle, circle or polygon, feathered outside it: to confine craters to an area or flatten a landing pad.

fields.name: shape
fields.description: Area the inner layer is applied in: a rectangle, a circle or a polygon.

fields.name: feather_m
fields.description: Distance in meters outside the shape over which the inner layer fades back to the unchanged height; 0 gives a hard edge. Must not be negative.

fields.name: blend
fields.description: Curve of the fade across the feather.

descriptions: Straight ramp: continuous, with kinks at both ends.
Cubic 3t^2 - 2t^3: continuous slope across the transition.
Quintic 6t^5 - 15t^4 + 10t^3: continuous slope and curvature, the smoothest join.
Gaussian falloff with sigma a third of the band, rescaled to end at zero.

fields.name: layer
fields.description: Layer applied only inside the shape. A crater layer here does not count as the crater layer for later boulder ejecta or secondaries.

alternatives.description: Secondary craters around the craters of the last crater layer before this one, after Singer et al. (2020).

fields.name: seed
fields.description: Seed the secondaries are drawn with; changing it gives a different field of the same statistics.

fields.name: onset_count
fields.description: Secondaries at least count_fraction primary diameters across, in an area the size of the primary at the onset range; the sources give sizes, not numbers. Must be positive. Required.

fields.name: count_fraction
fields.description: Size, as a fraction of the primary's diameter, from which the onset count counts secondaries. Must be positive.

fields.name: size_slope
fields.description: Cumulative size slope of the secondaries, their number falling as d^-slope; higher values give relatively more small secondaries. Must be positive.

fields.name: min_diameter_m
fields.description: Smallest secondary generated, in meters. Must be positive.

fields.name: max_diameter_m
fields.description: Largest secondary generated, in meters; unset has no limit beyond Singer et al.'s largest secondary at each range. Must be positive.

fields.name: outer_range
fields.description: How far secondaries reach, in primary diameters from its center; unset uses the longest typical ray of Elliott et al. (2018). Must be positive.

fields.name: min_primary_diameter_m
fields.description: Smallest diameter, in meters, of primary craters that throw secondaries. Must not be negative.

fields.name: max_primary_diameter_m
fields.description: Largest diameter, in meters, of primary craters that throw secondaries; unset has no upper limit. Must not be negative.

fields.name: min_age_gyr
fields.description: Youngest age, in Gyr, of primary craters that throw secondaries. Must not be negative.

fields.name: max_age_gyr
fields.description: Oldest age, in Gyr, of primary craters that throw secondaries; unset has no upper limit. Must not be negative.

fields.name: manual
fields.description: Lets manual primary craters throw secondaries too; otherwise only generated and replacing ones do.

fields.name: cell_size_factor
fields.description: Side of the polar cells secondaries are drawn in, as a multiple of each size band's largest diameter. Must be positive.

fields.name: rays
fields.description: Secondaries gathered into rays and clumped along them; off by default.

fields.name: shapes
fields.description: Secondaries stretched toward their primary; round by default.

fields.name: source_resolves_px
fields.description: Source cells across from which the source's data already holds the secondaries, by their diameter: only smaller ones are added, each raster of a chain giving its own limit. Ignored on synthetic sources and where no raster has data; null adds them all. Must be positive.

fields.name: depth_ratio
fields.description: Depth over diameter every secondary is given, with no wear by age; lower values give shallower secondaries. Must be positive.

fields.name: morphometry
fields.description: Published fits whose fresh crater rim the secondaries are shaped with.

descriptions: Fresh lunar craters: Fassett et al. (2022) depth and rim height below 15 km, Pike's (1977) complex crater fits above.
Fresh Martian craters: depth and rim height capped for small craters, Garvin et al.'s (2003) fits for large and complex craters from 7 km.

alternatives.description: Wind-blown dunes added to the terrain: isolated barchans or domes, or fields of transverse, barchanoid or linear crests, with slip faces and optional ripples on them.

fields.name: shape
fields.description: The kind of dune.

descriptions: Isolated crescents with a slip face and horns downwind; domes below min_width_m.
Isolated rounded heaps without a slip face.
Continuous crests across the wind, each with a slip face.
Transverse crests bent into linked crescents, as where sand supply rises.
Symmetric crests along the wind, as under two winds on scarce sand.

fields.name: wind_azimuth_deg
fields.description: Direction the wind blows toward, in degrees counter-clockwise from +x (local east on a body); slip faces face it.

fields.name: azimuth_spread_deg
fields.description: Largest difference of each barchan or dome's wind from the azimuth, in degrees. Must not be negative.

fields.name: slip_face_angle_deg
fields.description: Slope of the lee slip faces, in degrees: the sand's angle of repose. Must be above 0 and below 90 deg.

fields.name: stoss_slope_deg
fields.description: Mean slope of the windward faces, in degrees; below the slip face angle. Must be above 0 and below 90 deg.

fields.name: stoss_exponent
fields.description: Exponent alpha of the cos^alpha windward profile of dunes; higher is blunter. Must be positive.

fields.name: dome_exponent
fields.description: Exponent alpha of the cos^alpha profile of domes. Must be positive.

fields.name: lattice_spacing_m
fields.description: Barchans and domes: side of the lattice cells, each holding at most one dune, in meters. Must be positive.

fields.name: density
fields.description: Barchans and domes: chance a cell holds a dune. Must be from 0 to 1.

fields.name: width_m
fields.description: Barchans and domes: mean width, horn to horn, in meters. Must be positive.

fields.name: width_spread
fields.description: Barchans and domes: each width varies from (1 - spread) to (1 + spread) times the mean. Must be from 0 to below 1.

fields.name: min_width_m
fields.description: Barchans: width in meters below which a dune is a dome without a slip face, blending into barchans up to 1.5 times it. Must not be negative.

fields.name: height_ratio
fields.description: Barchans and domes: height over width. Must be positive.

fields.name: horn_length
fields.description: Barchans: how far the horns reach downwind of the crest, in dune heights. Must not be negative.

fields.name: dome_length
fields.description: Domes: length along the wind over width. Must be positive.

fields.name: wavelength_m
fields.description: Transverse, barchanoid and linear dunes: crest-to-crest spacing, in meters. Must be positive.

fields.name: height_m
fields.description: Transverse, barchanoid and linear dunes: crest height, in meters. Must not be negative.

fields.name: sinuosity
fields.description: Transverse, barchanoid and linear dunes: how far a crest wanders along its length, in wavelengths. Must not be negative.

fields.name: defects
fields.description: Transverse, barchanoid and linear dunes: share of the height that varies along crests, lowering and ending some. Must be from 0 to 1.

fields.name: defect_density
fields.description: Transverse, barchanoid and linear dunes: pairs of crest ends per meter of crest, so crests break into segments about 1 / defect_density long; 0 for none. Olympia Undae: 0.0027 (Ewing et al. 2010). Must not be negative.

fields.name: flank_slope_deg
fields.description: Linear dunes: mean slope of both flanks, in degrees. Must be above 0 and below 90 deg.

fields.name: seed
fields.description: Seed of the dunes and ripples; changing it gives a different layout of the same statistics.

fields.name: anchor_x
fields.description: On a body, the longitude in degrees of the point whose tangent frame the dunes are laid out in; they are true to scale near it and absent on the far hemisphere.

fields.name: anchor_y
fields.description: On a body, the latitude in degrees of the anchor.

fields.name: fade_px
fields.description: How dunes too fine for the sample spacing fade out, by samples across their width or wavelength. Each must not be negative.

fields.name: fade_shape
fields.description: Curve of the fade between the two sample counts of fade_px.

descriptions: Straight ramp: continuous, with kinks at both ends.
Cubic 3t^2 - 2t^3: continuous slope across the transition.
Quintic 6t^5 - 15t^4 + 10t^3: continuous slope and curvature, the smoothest join.
Gaussian falloff with sigma a third of the band, rescaled to end at zero.

fields.name: ripples
fields.description: Ripples superposed on the dunes; unset for none.

fields.name: grainflows
fields.description: Grainflows on the slip faces: scarps below the brink and lobes below them; unset for none.

fields.name: source_resolves_px
fields.description: Source cells across from which the source's data already holds the dunes, their ripples and grainflows, by their width or crest wavelength, ripple wavelength and narrowest lobe: only smaller ones are added, each raster of a chain giving its own limit. Ignored on synthetic sources and where no raster has data; null adds them all. Must be positive.

alternatives.description: Sand pooled in the lows of the ground beneath: cracks, troughs and hollows between rises, laying sand over the material map.

fields.name: reach_m
fields.description: Radius in meters of the surroundings a low is measured against: two rings, at half the reach and at the reach. Must be positive.

fields.name: fill
fields.description: Share of a low's depth below its surroundings that sand fills. Must be from 0 to 1.

fields.name: max_thickness_m
fields.description: The thickest the sand gets, in meters, approached smoothly. Must be positive.

fields.name: cover_thickness_m
fields.description: Sand thickness in meters from which it fully covers the ground in the material map. Must be positive.

alternatives.description: Fractured bedrock: polygonal plates, each tilted and stepped, parted by cracks or raised ridges, split again by finer octaves of cracks; lays bedrock over the material map.

fields.name: plate_size_m
fields.description: Mean plate width, in meters. Must be positive.

fields.name: jitter
fields.description: How far plate centers stray from a square lattice; 0 gives square plates. Must be from 0 to 1.

fields.name: warp
fields.description: Bend and roughness of the plate edges, in plate sizes. Must not be negative.

fields.name: crack_width_m
fields.description: Width of the cracks between plates, in meters. Must be positive.

fields.name: crack_depth_m
fields.description: Depth of the cracks, or height of the ridges when raised, in meters. Must not be negative.

fields.name: raised
fields.description: Whether plates are parted by raised ridges instead of cracks.

fields.name: edge_rounding_m
fields.description: Width of the rounded shoulder beside each crack, in meters. Must not be negative.

fields.name: max_tilt_deg
fields.description: Largest tilt of a plate, in degrees. Must be from 0 to below 90 deg.

fields.name: max_step_m
fields.description: Largest height offset of a plate, up or down, in meters. Must not be negative.

fields.name: octaves
fields.description: Crack octaves: each finer octave splits every plate again, its cracks ending at the plate's edges. Must be from 1 to 8.

fields.name: lacunarity
fields.description: Plate size ratio between octaves. Must be above 1.

fields.name: gain
fields.description: Ratio of crack width, depth, rounding, tilt and step between octaves. Must be above 0 and at most 1.

fields.name: seed
fields.description: Seed of the plates.

fields.name: exposure
fields.description: Shows plates only where the ground beneath is bare bedrock, fading out over soil; unset shows them everywhere.

fields.name: exposure_spacing_m
fields.description: Spacing in meters the ground is read at for the exposure field. Must be positive.

fields.name: anchor_x
fields.description: On a body, the longitude in degrees of the point whose tangent frame the plates are laid out in.

fields.name: anchor_y
fields.description: On a body, the latitude in degrees of the anchor.

fields.name: fade_px
fields.description: How plates and cracks too fine for the sample spacing fade out, by samples across them. Each must not be negative.

fields.name: fade_shape
fields.description: Curve of the fade between the two sample counts of fade_px.

descriptions: Straight ramp: continuous, with kinks at both ends.
Cubic 3t^2 - 2t^3: continuous slope across the transition.
Quintic 6t^5 - 15t^4 + 10t^3: continuous slope and curvature, the smoothest join.
Gaussian falloff with sigma a third of the band, rescaled to end at zero.

alternatives.description: Layered rock: the ground beneath terraced into dipping beds, each a flat bench below a cliff, so hills become stepped buttes and mesas; lays bedrock over the cliffs.

fields.name: bed_thickness_m
fields.description: Mean thickness of a bed, in meters. Must be positive.

fields.name: thickness_variation
fields.description: How far each bed boundary strays from even spacing, in bed thicknesses. Must be from 0 to below 1.

fields.name: dip_deg
fields.description: Dip of the beds from horizontal, in degrees. Must be from 0 to below 90 deg.

fields.name: dip_azimuth_deg
fields.description: Direction the beds dip toward, in degrees counter-clockwise from +x (local east on a body).

fields.name: sharpness
fields.description: How sharply each bed is cut into a flat bench and a cliff; 1 leaves the ground as it is. Must be at least 1.

fields.name: strength
fields.description: Share of the terracing applied. Must be from 0 to 1.

fields.name: cliff_share
fields.description: Share of each bed's height, at its top, laid as bedrock in the material map. Must be above 0 and at most 1.

fields.name: seed
fields.description: Seed of the bed boundaries.

fields.name: anchor_x
fields.description: On a body, the longitude in degrees of the point whose tangent frame the dip is measured in.

fields.name: anchor_y
fields.description: On a body, the latitude in degrees of the anchor.

fields.name: hard_share
fields.description: Share of the beds that are hard rock: hard beds form benches and cliffs of bedrock, soft beds slopes cut at soft_sharpness without bedrock. Must be from 0 to 1.

fields.name: soft_sharpness
fields.description: How sharply soft beds are cut into benches and slopes; 1 leaves them as they are. Must be at least 1.

alternatives.description: Sand shadows: a tapering sand tail in the lee of each boulder of the nearest boulder layer before this one; lays sand over the material map.

fields.name: wind_azimuth_deg
fields.description: Direction the wind blows toward, in degrees counter-clockwise from +x (local east on a body); tails trail away from boulders along it.

fields.name: length_ratio
fields.description: Length of a tail beyond its boulder over the boulder's width; 1.1 is the reattachment length behind a dome, and modeled shadow dunes run 1.3 to 5.6, longer in lighter winds. Must be positive.

fields.name: flank_angle_deg
fields.description: Slope of a tail's flanks, in degrees, at most the angle of repose (about 32 for dry sand); sets the tail's height with the boulder's width. Must be above 0 and below 90 deg.

fields.name: min_diameter_m
fields.description: Smallest boulder with a tail, in meters. Must not be negative.

fields.name: cover_thickness_m
fields.description: Sand depth that fully covers the ground in the material map, in meters. Must be positive.

fields.name: fade_px
fields.description: How tails behind boulders too small for the sample spacing fade out, by samples across the boulder. Each must not be negative.

fields.name: fade_shape
fields.description: Curve of the fade between the two sample counts of fade_px.

descriptions: Straight ramp: continuous, with kinks at both ends.
Cubic 3t^2 - 2t^3: continuous slope across the transition.
Quintic 6t^5 - 15t^4 + 10t^3: continuous slope and curvature, the smoothest join.
Gaussian falloff with sigma a third of the band, rescaled to end at zero.

alternatives.description: Detail finer than the source continuing its measured power-law spectrum to shorter wavelengths with random phases, as sparse Gabor noise: an alternative to diamond-square upsampling without lattice artifacts.

fields.name: pixel_size_m
fields.description: Cell size of the source in meters; the detail starts at twice it. Unset uses the source's cell size. Must be positive.

fields.name: slope
fields.description: Spectral slope beta of the radially averaged power spectrum, P(f) ~ f^-beta: beta = 2 H + 2 for Hurst exponent H. Unset fits it to the source. Must be from 2 to 4.

fields.name: octave_rms_m
fields.description: RMS height in meters the power law holds at wavelengths from one to two source pixels. Unset fits it to the source. Must not be negative.

fields.name: fit_min_pixels
fields.description: Shortest wavelength, in source pixels, the source's spectrum is fitted over. Must be at least 2.

fields.name: fit_max_pixels
fields.description: Longest wavelength, in source pixels, the source's spectrum is fitted over; 0 for a quarter of the window the spectrum is measured on (at most 512 cells a side). Must not be negative.

fields.name: min_wavelength_m
fields.description: Shortest wavelength of the detail in meters; the detail spans the wavelengths from twice the source's pixel size down to it. Must be positive.

fields.name: taper_octaves
fields.description: Octaves above the source's Nyquist frequency over which the detail fades in, so it adds nothing at wavelengths the source resolves. Must be positive.

fields.name: seed
fields.description: Seed of the detail; changing it gives a different pattern of the same spectrum.

fields.name: fade_px
fields.description: How wavelengths too fine for the sample spacing fade out, by samples per wavelength. Each must not be negative.

fields.name: fade_shape
fields.description: Curve of the fade between the two sample counts of fade_px.

descriptions: Straight ramp: continuous, with kinks at both ends.
Cubic 3t^2 - 2t^3: continuous slope across the transition.
Quintic 6t^5 - 15t^4 + 10t^3: continuous slope and curvature, the smoothest join.
Gaussian falloff with sigma a third of the band, rescaled to end at zero.

fields.description: [width, height] of the box; give it with center. Each must be positive.

fields.description: GeoTIFF file to write; unset to only return the result, writing nothing; relative paths resolve against the output folder (the CLI's --output-dir), else the configuration's folder.

fields.name: pixel_size_m
fields.description: Cell size in meters of the file; on a body, meters along a meridian, the same in degrees of longitude. Unset for the source's cell size; required without a raster or chain source. Must be positive.

fields.name: extent_m
fields.description: Box the output covers on a plane in meters, snapped outward from its min corner to whole cells; unset for the source's extent, required without a raster or chain source.

fields.name: extent_deg
fields.description: As extent_m on a body, in degrees of longitude (x) and latitude (y).

fields.name: compression
fields.description: Compression of the file; compressed files use the floating-point predictor.

descriptions: Uncompressed: the largest files.
Lossless LZW compression, widely supported.
Lossless Deflate (zlib) compression.
PackBits run-length compression; read only, so outputs cannot use it.

fields.name: tile_size_px
fields.description: Width and height of the file's tiles in pixels; a multiple of 16. Must be at least 16 px.

alternatives.description: A JSON report of what the configuration generates: height, slope, crater bin and boulder statistics per evaluated grid, per-layer timings, backend, threads, seeds and version.

fields.name: path
fields.description: File to write the report to; unset to only return the result, writing nothing; relative paths resolve against the output folder (the CLI's --output-dir), else the configuration's folder.

fields.name: enabled
fields.description: Includes this layer in the stack; disabled layers are skipped.

fields.name: basis
fields.description: Single-octave noise the fractal is built from.

descriptions: Improved Perlin gradient noise: smooth, general-purpose relief.
Simplex gradient noise: smooth relief, an alternative to Perlin.
Value noise: random values interpolated over a lattice; blockier than gradient noise.
Cellular noise from the distance to the nearest feature point: cones and basins.
Cellular noise from the distance to the second-nearest feature point.
Cellular noise F2 - F1: ridges along cell borders, like cracked ground.
Voronoi cells, each at one random height: flat polygonal plateaus and terraces.

fields.name: fractal
fields.description: How the octaves of the basis noise are combined.

descriptions: Fractional Brownian motion: a weighted sum of octaves, the general-purpose choice.
Ridged multifractal: sharp crests from inverted absolute noise, like eroded ridges.
Sum of absolute-value octaves: rounded, puffy forms.
Hybrid multifractal: smooth lowlands and rough highlands.

fields.name: blend
fields.description: How this layer combines with the height of the layers before it; the first enabled layer sets the height instead.

descriptions: Adds the layer to the height so far.
Keeps the higher of the height so far and the layer.
Keeps the lower of the height so far and the layer.
Multiplies the height so far by (layer / amplitude + 1) / 2, so the layer modulates roughness by region.

fields.name: seed
fields.description: Seed of the noise; changing it gives a different pattern of the same character.

fields.name: wavelength_m
fields.description: Wavelength of the first, broadest octave, in meters; sets the size of the largest features. Must be positive.

fields.name: amplitude
fields.description: Largest value of the layer above or below 0, in what its stack varies: relative brightness, saturation or degrees of hue. Required.

fields.name: octaves
fields.description: Number of octaves; each one adds detail at a shorter wavelength. Must be from 1 to 32.

fields.name: lacunarity
fields.description: Frequency ratio between successive octaves. Must be above 1.

fields.name: gain
fields.description: Weight ratio between successive octaves; higher values give rougher terrain. Unused when the Hurst exponent is set. Must be positive.

fields.name: hurst
fields.description: Hurst exponent that sets the octave gain to lacunarity^-hurst: near 1 is smooth, lower is rougher at short baselines. Unset uses the gain.

fields.name: offset
fields.description: Ridge offset of the ridged and hybrid multifractal types. Must be positive.

fields.name: warp_amplitude_m
fields.description: Domain warp displacement in meters, which bends the noise into swirled shapes; 0 disables warping. Must not be negative.

fields.name: warp_wavelength_m
fields.description: Wavelength of the warp field, in meters. Must be positive.

fields.name: enabled
fields.description: Adds fractal detail below the map's resolution; off leaves the interpolated map as it is.

fields.name: seed
fields.description: Seed of the detail noise; changing it gives a different pattern of the same roughness.

fields.name: octaves
fields.description: Octaves of detail, from half the map's cell size down, each half the wavelength of the one before. Must be from 1 to 16.

fields.name: scale
fields.description: Factor on the RMS of every octave; 0 adds no detail, higher values give a more mottled albedo. Must not be negative.

fields.name: hurst
fields.description: Hurst exponent used instead of the one measured from the map; lower values keep more contrast at fine scales. Unset uses the measured one. Must be from 0 to 1.

fields.name: fade_px
fields.description: How octaves of detail too fine for the sample spacing fade out. Each must not be negative.

fields.name: fade_shape
fields.description: Curve of the fade between the two sample counts of fade_px.

descriptions: Straight ramp: continuous, with kinks at both ends.
Cubic 3t^2 - 2t^3: continuous slope across the transition.
Quintic 6t^5 - 15t^4 + 10t^3: continuous slope and curvature, the smoothest join.
Gaussian falloff with sigma a third of the band, rescaled to end at zero.

alternatives.description: A base color in hue, saturation and value, each varied by noise: an albedo for terrain without data.

fields.name: rgb
fields.description: Gives three bands, red, green and blue, from the color; off gives one band of the value alone, ignoring hue and saturation.

fields.name: hue_deg
fields.description: Hue of the base color in degrees, wrapping around; used with rgb only.

fields.name: saturation
fields.description: Saturation of the base color, 0 for gray; used with rgb only. Must be from 0 to 1.

fields.name: value
fields.description: Reflectance of the brightest band; the one band's value without rgb. Higher values give a brighter surface. Must be from 0 to 1.

fields.name: hue_noise_deg
fields.description: Noise layers whose sum in degrees is added to the hue; used with rgb only. Holds 0 to 8 items.

fields.name: saturation_noise
fields.description: Noise layers added to the saturation, which is then clamped to [0, 1]; used with rgb only. Holds 0 to 8 items.

fields.name: value_noise
fields.description: Noise layers: the value is multiplied by 1 plus their sum and clamped to [0, 1], so their amplitude sets the relative contrast. Holds 0 to 8 items.

alternatives.description: Albedo read from one or three bands of a GeoTIFF in the terrain's projection, such as an orbital albedo map.

fields.name: path
fields.description: GeoTIFF albedo map in the terrain's projected coordinates; relative paths resolve against the configuration's folder. Required.

fields.name: bands
fields.description: Bands of the file to read, counting from 0: one for a single albedo band, or three for red, green and blue. Holds 1 or 3 items.

fields.name: scale
fields.description: Factor each sample is multiplied by, replacing the band's scale from the file's GDAL metadata, as for maps stored as integers. Unset keeps the file's.

fields.name: offset
fields.description: Added to each scaled sample, replacing the band's offset from the file's GDAL metadata. Unset keeps the file's.

fields.name: resampling
fields.description: Interpolation used to sample the map at the terrain's points.

descriptions: The value of the nearest cell center: blocky, but never mixes values.
Linear in each axis over the four surrounding cells.
Keys cubic convolution (a = -0.5) over the sixteen surrounding cells: smooth, for upscaling DEMs.
Another name for cubic: the Catmull-Rom spline is the same kernel.
The three-lobe Lanczos kernel over the 36 surrounding cells: sharper than cubic, with slight ringing at steps.
The cubic B-spline over the sixteen surrounding cells: the smoothest, but it smooths the cells themselves.

fields.name: detail
fields.description: Fractal detail below the map's resolution, continuing the map's own measured roughness to finer scales.

fields.name: streaks
fields.description: Share of the excess radial streaks take away between filaments, breaking ejecta, rays and interiors into fine streaks; 0 leaves them smooth. Must be from 0 to 1.

fields.name: streak_width_deg
fields.description: Typical width of a filament around the crater, in degrees. Must be positive.

fields.name: streak_length_radii
fields.description: Typical length of a filament outward from the crater, in crater radii. Must be positive.

fields.name: continuous_radii
fields.description: How far beyond the rim the ejecta stay continuous before breaking into filaments, in crater radii; 0 streaks them from the rim. Must not be negative.

fields.name: lobes
fields.description: How far the ejecta's edge wanders in and out, as a share of its reach; 0 keeps it circular. Must be from 0 to 0.9.

fields.name: lobe_count
fields.description: Typical number of lobes around a crater. Must be from 1 to 64.

fields.name: floor_share
fields.description: Interior excess on the floor over that at the rim; 1 keeps the interior even, lower values brighten the walls over the floor. Must be from 0 to 1.

fields.name: seed
fields.description: Varies every crater's texture.

fields.name: share
fields.description: Share of craters with the zone. Must be from 0 to 1.

fields.name: change
fields.description: Reflectance change relative to the pre-impact surface, drawn per crater; above -1, negative values darken.

fields.name: coefficient_m
fields.description: Coefficient of the zone's reach from the crater's center, coefficient D^exponent meters for diameter D in meters. Must be positive.

fields.name: exponent
fields.description: Exponent of the diameter in the zone's reach. Must be positive.

fields.name: scale
fields.description: Factor on the reach, drawn per crater; positive and bounded, a wider distribution gives more varied zones.

fields.name: raggedness
fields.description: Share of the reach that fingers of the edge pull in by; 0 keeps the zone round, higher values make it ray-like. Must be from 0 to below 1.

fields.name: finger_width_deg
fields.description: Typical width of the edge's fingers around the crater, in degrees. Must be positive.

fields.name: feather
fields.description: Share of the reach over which the zone fades out at its edge. Must be above 0 and at most 1.

fields.name: retention_myr
fields.description: How long the zone lasts, in Myr, fading like the bright material; unset lasts as long as the bright material. Must be positive.

fields.name: enabled
fields.description: Gives the distal zones shadows behind rises such as crater rims, read from the terrain's heights; off by default.

fields.name: jet_angle_deg
fields.description: Steepest angle in degrees at which the jet forming the distal zones can drop behind a rise; lower values give longer shadows. Illustrative. Must be above 0 and below 90 deg.

fields.name: depth_m
fields.description: Depth in meters of the ground below the jet at which the shadow is full. Illustrative. Must be positive.

fields.name: azimuths
fields.description: Rays around a crater the ground is sampled on. Must be from 8 to 8192.

fields.name: radial_samples
fields.description: Samples along each ray out to the distal zones' reach. Must be from 8 to 8192.

fields.name: enabled
fields.description: Gives new small craters the reflectance zones of LROC temporal pairs; off by default.

fields.name: max_diameter_m
fields.description: Largest crater diameter, in meters, with zones; the published fits stop near 43 m. Must be positive.

fields.name: mature_depth_m
fields.description: Depth in meters of mature regolith; only craters excavating deeper get the proximal high reflectance zone. Must not be negative.

fields.name: excavation_ratio
fields.description: Excavation depth over crater diameter. Must be positive.

fields.name: proximal_high
fields.description: Proximal high reflectance zone: immature ejecta, +12% to a median 1.5 D.

fields.name: proximal_low
fields.description: Proximal low reflectance zone: -9% to a median 2.9 D, around nearly every crater.

fields.name: distal_high
fields.description: Distal high reflectance zone: +1% to +4% to 0.52 D^2.5 m, around 24% of craters.

fields.name: distal_low
fields.description: Distal low reflectance zone: -2% to -6%, ray-like, to 5.03 D^2 m, around 84% of craters.

fields.name: shadows
fields.description: Shadows of rises in the distal zones; off by default.

fields.name: seed
fields.description: Varies every crater's zones.

fields.name: enabled
fields.description: Draws an impact angle and direction per crater that shape its rays; off treats every impact as vertical.

fields.name: heading_deg
fields.description: Downrange direction of every impact, in degrees counter-clockwise from +x (local east on a body); unset draws a random heading per crater.

fields.name: asymmetric_deg
fields.description: Impact angle from the horizontal, in degrees, below which ejecta leave faster downrange, lengthening rays there and shortening them uprange. Must be from 0 to 90 deg.

fields.name: forbidden_deg
fields.description: Impact angle in degrees below which rays within the zone half width of uprange are dropped; at most the asymmetric angle. Must be from 0 to 90 deg.

fields.name: butterfly_deg
fields.description: Impact angle in degrees below which rays within the zone half width of downrange are dropped too, a butterfly pattern; at most the forbidden angle. Must be from 0 to 90 deg.

fields.name: downrange_speed_ratio
fields.description: Downrange over uprange ejection speed below the asymmetric angle, drawn per crater; at least 1, higher values stretch downrange rays more.

fields.name: zone_half_width_deg
fields.description: Half width in degrees of the ray-free zones uprange and downrange; illustrative, as the sources do not measure it. Must be from 0 to 180 deg.

fields.name: enabled
fields.description: Gives craters rays of bright material; off leaves only their interiors and ejecta bright.

fields.name: count
fields.description: Number of rays of a crater, drawn per crater and rounded; from 0 to 64.

fields.name: length_coefficient
fields.description: Coefficient of the median ray length, coefficient R^exponent km for crater radius R in km; higher values give longer rays. Must be positive.

fields.name: length_exponent
fields.description: Exponent of the crater radius in the median ray length; higher values make large craters' rays relatively longer. Must be positive.

fields.name: length_spread
fields.description: Natural logarithm of a ray's length over the median, drawn per ray; a wider distribution gives more varied lengths.

fields.name: width_deg
fields.description: Angle in degrees a ray spans 2 radii from the center, drawn per ray, within (0, 180); beyond 2 radii a ray keeps the width it has there.

fields.name: excess
fields.description: Optical maturity above the background along a ray at the rim, falling linearly to 0 at its end; higher values give brighter rays. Must not be negative.

fields.name: patchiness
fields.description: Share of a ray's strength that noise along it can take away, breaking it into patches; 0 gives unbroken rays. Must be from 0 to 1.

fields.name: patch_radii
fields.description: Wavelength of the noise along a ray, in crater radii; smaller values give shorter patches. Must be positive.

fields.name: oblique
fields.description: How oblique impacts lengthen rays downrange and clear them uprange.

fields.name: layout
fields.description: Takes the rays' number, directions and widths from this layout in place of count and width_deg, so they lie over a secondaries layer with the same layout; unset draws them per crater.

fields.name: small_diameter_m
fields.description: Diameter in meters at or below which craters keep their bright material for the small time. Must be positive.

fields.name: small_myr
fields.description: Time in Myr craters up to the small diameter keep their bright material. Must be positive.

fields.name: mid_diameter_m
fields.description: Diameter in meters from which craters keep their bright material for the mid time; between the small and mid diameters the time follows a power law of diameter. Must be positive.

fields.name: mid_myr
fields.description: Time in Myr craters from the mid to the large diameter keep their bright material. Must be positive.

fields.name: large_diameter_m
fields.description: Diameter in meters above which craters keep their bright material for the large time. Must be positive.

fields.name: large_myr
fields.description: Time in Myr craters above the large diameter keep their bright material. Must be positive.

fields.name: scale
fields.description: Factor every retention time is multiplied by; higher values keep craters bright for longer. Must be positive.

fields.name: enabled
fields.description: Gives new craters swarms of splotches, their ejecta's secondaries (Robinson et al. 2015); off by default.

fields.name: crater_rate
fields.description: New craters at least 10 m across per km^2 per year; 4.84e-6 from Speyerer et al. (2016). Must be positive.

fields.name: crater_slope
fields.description: Cumulative size slope of the new craters; the Neukum production function has 2.97 to 3.15. Must be positive.

fields.name: min_crater_diameter_m
fields.description: Smallest crater with a swarm, in meters; smaller craters throw few splotches. Must be positive.

fields.name: max_crater_diameter_m
fields.description: Largest crater with a swarm, in meters. Must be positive.

fields.name: reference_diameter_m
fields.description: Diameter in meters of the crater whose swarm was counted: 18.8 m, Robinson et al. Must be positive.

fields.name: reference_count
fields.description: Splotches of the reference crater: 248 within 30 km, Robinson et al. Must be positive.

fields.name: mu
fields.description: Velocity exponent of the target; 0.41 for sand (Housen and Holsapple 2011). Counts grow as D^(3 + 1.5 mu) and landing distances fall as r^(-1.5 mu). Must be above 0 and below 1.

fields.name: min_range_m
fields.description: Nearest landing distance in meters, setting Robinson et al.'s median of 8.7 km. Must be positive.

fields.name: max_range_m
fields.description: Farthest landing distance in meters. Must be positive.

fields.name: splotch_diameter
fields.description: Diameter of a swarm splotch in meters, drawn per splotch: 2 to 22 m, median 6 m.

fields.name: dark_share
fields.description: Share of swarm splotches darker than the ground. Must be from 0 to 1.

fields.name: bright_share
fields.description: Share brighter than the ground; the rest are mixed. Must be from 0 to 1.

fields.name: dark_change
fields.description: Reflectance change of a dark swarm splotch.

fields.name: bright_change
fields.description: Reflectance change of a bright swarm splotch.

fields.name: wedge_share
fields.description: Share of swarm splotches shaped as wedges pointing back to their crater. Illustrative. Must be from 0 to 1.

fields.name: wedge_elongation
fields.description: Long over short axis of a wedge. Illustrative. Must be at least 1.

fields.name: craters
fields.description: New craters given by hand, such as an observed impact, each throwing a swarm.

fields.name: x
fields.description: Surface x of the lander.

fields.name: y
fields.description: Surface y of the lander.

fields.name: area
fields.description: Area of the blast zone in m^2; measured: Apollo 18,725 to 53,872 (mean 28,785), Luna 987 to 3355 (mean 2100), Surveyor 131 to 279 (mean 215), Chang'e-3 2530. Must be positive.

fields.name: elongation
fields.description: Long over short axis of the zone; Apollo about 1.14, Chang'e-3 about 1.74. Must be at least 1.

fields.name: heading_deg
fields.description: Direction of the long axis, degrees counter-clockwise from east, such as along the final approach.

fields.name: change
fields.description: Mean reflectance change over the zone relative to undisturbed ground at 30 degrees phase; measured +3.4% to +13.2%, Apollo mean +10.9%. Must be above -1.

fields.name: halo_change
fields.description: Reflectance change of the fainter halo beyond the zone; +4% at Chang'e-3. Must be above -1.

fields.name: halo_reach
fields.description: How far the halo reaches over the zone's own reach; 1 for no halo. Must be at least 1.

fields.name: core_radius_m
fields.description: Radius in meters of the darker core beneath the engine and around the crew's tracks; 0 for none, a few meters at the Apollo sites. Must not be negative.

fields.name: core_change
fields.description: Reflectance change of the dark core; -15% to -30% at the Apollo sites. Must be above -1.

fields.name: raggedness
fields.description: Share of the zone's radius that lobes of its edge pull in by. Must be from 0 to below 1.

fields.name: seed
fields.description: Varies the edge's lobes.

alternatives.description: Bright ejecta, interiors and rays of the craters of a crater layer, fading with crater age.

fields.name: crater_layer
fields.description: Which top-level crater layer's craters to brighten, counting from 0; unset uses every top-level crater layer.

fields.name: seed
fields.description: Seed of which craters get bright material, their rays and their impacts; changing it gives a different pattern of the same statistics.

fields.name: min_diameter_m
fields.description: Smallest diameter, in meters, of craters given bright material. Must not be negative.

fields.name: max_diameter_m
fields.description: Largest diameter, in meters, of craters given bright material; unset has no upper limit. Must not be negative.

fields.name: min_age_gyr
fields.description: Youngest age, in Gyr, of craters given bright material. Must not be negative.

fields.name: max_age_gyr
fields.description: Oldest age, in Gyr, of craters given bright material; unset has no upper limit. Must not be negative.

fields.name: manual
fields.description: Gives manual craters bright material too; otherwise only generated and replacing craters have it.

fields.name: share
fields.description: Share of eligible craters given bright material. Must be from 0 to 1.

fields.name: background_maturity
fields.description: Optical maturity (OMAT) of the ground around the craters; the excesses are added to it and the albedo is brightened from it. Must be positive.

fields.name: max_maturity
fields.description: Cap on the optical maturity where craters' excesses add up, at least the background; it limits how bright overlapping craters get.

fields.name: interior_excess
fields.description: Optical maturity above the background inside a fresh crater's rim; higher values give brighter interiors. Must not be negative.

fields.name: texture
fields.description: Filaments, lobed ejecta edges and walls brighter than floors; off unless streaks, lobes or a floor share below 1 are set.

fields.name: zones
fields.description: Bright and dark reflectance zones around new small craters, after Robinson et al. (2015) and Speyerer et al. (2016); off by default.

fields.name: ejecta_excess
fields.description: Optical maturity above the background on a fresh crater's continuous ejecta at the rim, falling with distance. Must not be negative.

fields.name: ejecta_exponent
fields.description: Exponent of the ejecta's fall with distance r, as (r / R)^-exponent for crater radius R; higher values keep the bright ejecta nearer the rim. Must be positive.

fields.name: ejecta_reach_radii
fields.description: Distance from the center, in crater radii, at which the ejecta's excess reaches 0. Must be above 1.

fields.name: rays
fields.description: Rays of bright material running out from the craters.

fields.name: retention
fields.description: How long craters of each diameter keep their bright material.

fields.name: fade_exponent
fields.description: Exponent of the fade with age t, max(0, 1 - t / T)^exponent for retention time T; 1 is a straight fade and higher values fade sooner. Must be positive.

fields.name: origin_reflectance
fields.description: Reflectance of the optical maturity origin, the hypermature end-member, from which reflectance scales with maturity at fixed iron content.

fields.name: fade_px
fields.description: How bright material of craters too small to resolve at the sample spacing fades out. Each must not be negative.

fields.name: fade_shape
fields.description: Curve of the fade between the two sample counts of fade_px.

descriptions: Straight ramp: continuous, with kinks at both ends.
Cubic 3t^2 - 2t^3: continuous slope across the transition.
Quintic 6t^5 - 15t^4 + 10t^3: continuous slope and curvature, the smoothest join.
Gaussian falloff with sigma a third of the band, rescaled to end at zero.

alternatives.description: Dark and bright splotches that secondary impacts of loose regolith leave over the whole surface, after Speyerer et al. (2016).

fields.name: seed
fields.description: Seed of where splotches fall and what they are.

fields.name: rate_coefficient
fields.description: Coefficient a of the cumulative formation rate a d^-b per km^2 per year, d the diameter in km; higher values give more splotches. Must be positive.

fields.name: rate_exponent
fields.description: Slope b of the cumulative formation rate; higher values give relatively more small splotches. Must be positive.

fields.name: lifetime_myr
fields.description: How long a splotch lasts in Myr, fading linearly; the default is the time splotches take to churn the top centimeters. Must be positive.

fields.name: min_diameter_m
fields.description: Smallest splotch diameter in meters; the published fit is extrapolated below 10 m. Must be positive.

fields.name: max_diameter_m
fields.description: Largest splotch diameter in meters, above the smallest. Must be positive.

fields.name: dark_share
fields.description: Share of splotches darker than the ground. Must be from 0 to 1.

fields.name: bright_share
fields.description: Share of splotches brighter than the ground; the rest are mixed, dark on one side and bright on the other. Must be from 0 to 1.

fields.name: dark_change
fields.description: Reflectance change of a dark splotch relative to the ground before it, drawn per splotch; above -1.

fields.name: bright_change
fields.description: Reflectance change of a bright splotch, drawn per splotch; above -1.

fields.name: steep_bright_share
fields.description: Share of splotches on slopes steeper than the steep slope that are bright, read from the terrain's heights; unset keeps the bright share. Bright splotches are found mostly on such slopes, but the source gives no share. Must be from 0 to 1.

fields.name: steep_slope_deg
fields.description: Slope in degrees from which ground is steep. Must be above 0 and below 90 deg.

fields.name: softness
fields.description: Share of a splotch's radius over which its edge fades. Must be above 0 and at most 1.

fields.name: raggedness
fields.description: Share of a splotch's radius that lobes of its edge pull in by; 0 keeps it round. Must be from 0 to below 1.

fields.name: fade_px
fields.description: How splotches too small to resolve at the sample spacing fade out. Each must not be negative.

fields.name: fade_shape
fields.description: Curve of the fade between the two sample counts of fade_px.

descriptions: Straight ramp: continuous, with kinks at both ends.
Cubic 3t^2 - 2t^3: continuous slope across the transition.
Quintic 6t^5 - 15t^4 + 10t^3: continuous slope and curvature, the smoothest join.
Gaussian falloff with sigma a third of the band, rescaled to end at zero.

fields.name: swarms
fields.description: Swarms of splotches around new craters; off by default.

alternatives.description: Brighter zones of regolith around landers scoured by their descent engines, after Clegg et al. (2014) and Clegg-Watkins et al. (2016).

fields.name: zones
fields.description: One blast zone per lander.

alternatives.description: Rock brighter than the regolith: the boulders of boulder layers where resolved, and a speckle of the share of each sample covered by those too small to resolve.

fields.name: boulder_layer
fields.description: Which top-level boulder layer's rock to brighten, counting from 0; unset uses every top-level boulder layer.

fields.name: seed
fields.description: Seed of the per-sample draws of rock too small to resolve.

fields.name: reflectance_ratio
fields.description: Rock reflectance over the regolith's; 2.5 after Marshal et al. (2023), within Holt's (1981) Apollo 16 rocks at 18 to 51% against soils of 14 to 15%; earlier models used 1.5. Must be positive.

fields.name: unresolved
fields.description: Brightens each sample by the share of it covered by boulders too small to resolve, drawn about the expected share with the scatter of randomly placed rocks: bright speckle.

alternatives.description: Steep ground kept immature and bright by regolith moving downslope, after Ikeda et al. (2022) and Lucey et al. (2014).

fields.name: onset_deg
fields.description: Slope in degrees from which ground freshens; 20, where Lucey et al. (2014) and Ikeda et al. (2022) find brightening begin. Must be from 0 to below 90 deg.

fields.name: maturity_per_degree
fields.description: Optical maturity (OMAT) gained per degree beyond the onset; about 0.0065 on the crater walls of Ikeda et al. (2022). Must not be negative.

fields.name: background_maturity
fields.description: OMAT of gentler ground; about 0.10 at 20 degrees in Laue (Ikeda et al. 2022). Must be positive.

fields.name: max_maturity
fields.description: Cap on OMAT; at least the background's. Must be positive.

fields.name: baseline_m
fields.description: Meters slopes are measured over, the spacing of the lattice they are read on; 10, the DTM Ikeda et al. (2022) measured slopes on. Must be positive.

fields.name: origin_reflectance
fields.description: Reflectance of the optical maturity origin, from which reflectance scales with maturity at fixed iron content.

fields.name: source
fields.description: Base albedo of the terrain, before its layers: a synthetic color or a raster map.

fields.name: layers
fields.description: Layers applied to the source's albedo in order, such as bright crater ejecta and rays.

fields.name: albedo
fields.description: Single-scattering albedo w. Must be from 0 to 1.

fields.name: b
fields.description: Asymmetry b of the two-term Henyey-Greenstein phase function. Must be from 0 to 1.

fields.name: c
fields.description: Backscatter fraction c of the two-term Henyey-Greenstein phase function. Must be from 0 to 1.

fields.name: roughness_deg
fields.description: Macroscopic roughness theta-bar, in degrees. Must be from 0 to below 90 deg.

fields.name: reference
fields.description: Published Hapke parameters to start from; each class given below replaces its own.

descriptions: No parameters: each class present must be given.
Pancam fits at 753 nm (Johnson et al. 2006a, b, tabulated by Fernando et al. 2013): soil, sand, dust, bedrock (Eagle crater outcrop, Johnson et al. 2006b) and rock.

fields.name: soil
fields.description: Hapke parameters of soil; unset keeps the reference's.

fields.name: sand
fields.description: Hapke parameters of sand; unset keeps the reference's.

fields.name: dust
fields.description: Hapke parameters of dust; unset keeps the reference's.

fields.name: bedrock
fields.description: Hapke parameters of bedrock; unset keeps the reference's.

fields.name: rock
fields.description: Hapke parameters of rocks and boulders; unset keeps the reference's.

fields.name: exposure
fields.description: Thresholds marking bare ground as bedrock, read on the ground beneath the first layer that lays a material; unset for no bedrock.

fields.name: dust_cover
fields.description: About the share of the surface under bright dust patches. Must be from 0 to below 1.

fields.name: dust_patch_m
fields.description: Typical width of a dust patch, in meters. Must be positive.

fields.name: seed
fields.description: Seed of the dust patches.

fields.name: photometry
fields.description: Hapke parameters of each material class, which photometry outputs mix.
